"""Read-only ELM327 protocol identification — adapter transport injected by client.

The host that owns USB/Bluetooth/Wi-Fi establishes the physical link. The
backend owns the shared protocol classification and ECU response validation.
Never issue Mode 04, UDS 2E/31/34/36, security access or actuations.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import Awaitable, Callable, Any

from vehicle.protocol.registry import read_elm_detected_protocol

AsyncCommand = Callable[[str], Awaitable[str]]


def is_obd_mode_01_supported_pids_reply(raw: str) -> bool:
    """A Mode 01 PID 00 reply starts with 41 00 after optional headers.

    Adapter echoes and SEARCHING are ignored. This is stronger than ATDPN,
    but not proof that every other service/ECU is compatible.
    """
    lines = re.split(r"[\r\n>]+", raw.upper())
    for line in lines:
        compact = re.sub(r"[^0-9A-F]", "", line)
        # Full ELM CAN headers like 7E8 06 41 00 xx... can precede 4100.
        # Four bytes form the PID-00 supported-PIDs bitmask. A partial
        # "41 00" header alone is not ECU communication evidence.
        if re.search(r"4100[0-9A-F]{8}", compact):
            return True
    return False


async def discover_elm_obd_protocol(command: AsyncCommand) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Read-only *vehicle request* detection using an existing adapter link.

    ATSP0 selects adapter automatic protocol; it does not reprogram a vehicle.
    Mode 0100 queries supported standard OBD PIDs. ATDPN reads adapter mode.
    """
    commands: list[str] = []
    try:
        for message in ("ATSP0", "0100", "ATDPN"):
            result = await command(message)
            commands.append(message)
            if not isinstance(result, str):
                raise ValueError(f"Adapter reply for {message} was not text")
            if message == "0100":
                mode_reply = result
            if message == "ATDPN":
                dpn_reply = result
        observed = read_elm_detected_protocol(dpn_reply)
        ecu_replied = is_obd_mode_01_supported_pids_reply(mode_reply)
        return {
            **observed,
            "confirmed_ecu_communication": ecu_replied,
            "status": (
                "ecu_observed" if ecu_replied and observed["protocol_id"]
                else "adapter_only" if observed["protocol_id"]
                else "unrecognized"
            ),
            "commands": commands,
            "scope": "generic emissions Mode 01 PID 00 only",
            "supported_ecu_services": ["01-00"] if ecu_replied else [],
            "note": "No DTC clearing, actuator tests or manufacturer UDS requests performed.",
        }
    except Exception as exc:
        return {
            "status": "error", "protocol_id": None,
            "confirmed_ecu_communication": False,
            "commands": commands, "error_type": type(exc).__name__,
            "note": "Communication failed; protocol unknown. Do not assume compatibility.",
        }

"""Authoritative BACKEND catalogue of standards; not an assertion of hardware support.

Transport (CAN/K-Line/Ethernet), diagnostics (UDS/OBD/J1939), and adapter
capability are separate. Vehicle make/model never confirms a protocol.
Only an observed adapter/ECU handshake can provide measured evidence.

def read_elm_detected_protocol(raw: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Parse an observed ELM327 ATDPN reply: A6/6, A3/3, etc.

    This function does not communicate with hardware or send AT commands.
    No success claim is made from a configured setting without an observation.
    """
    normalized = raw.strip().upper().replace(" ", "").replace("\r", "").replace("\n", "")
    auto_selected = normalized.startswith("A")
    code = normalized[1:] if auto_selected else normalized
    protocol = BY_ELM_CODE.get(code) if len(code) == 1 else None
    return {
        "raw": raw,
        "adapter_observation": "ATDPN",
        "protocol_id": protocol.id if protocol else None,
        "auto_selected": auto_selected,
        "evidence": "adapter_reported" if protocol else "unrecognized",

def assess_protocols(
    *, year: int, market: str = "unknown", make: str = "",
    fuel: str = "", vehicle_class: str = "passenger",
    detected_elm: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Conservative compatibility HINTS, never make/model-to-ECU assertions."""
    market = market.strip().upper()
    vehicle_class = vehicle_class.strip().lower()
    fuel = fuel.strip().lower()
    make = make.strip().lower()
    candidates: list[str] = []
    warnings: list[str] = []
    if year < 1886 or year > 2100:
        raise ValueError("year outside supported range")
    heavy = vehicle_class in {"heavy", "heavy-duty", "truck-heavy", "bus", "commercial-heavy"}
    if heavy:
        _add(candidates, "j1939_250", "j1939_500", "wwh_obd")
        if year < 2006:
            _add(candidates, "j1708_j1587")
        # CARB's J1979-2 transition is model-year AND certification-specific.
        # Never assign it to every global truck in 2023 or later.
        if market in {"US", "USA", "CA", "CALIFORNIA"} and year >= 2027:
            _add(candidates, "obdonuds")
            warnings.append("2027+ CARB-certified heavy-duty engines transition to OBDonUDS; verify certification/VIN.")
        elif year >= 2024 and make in {"volvo", "mack"} and market in {"US", "USA", "CA", "CALIFORNIA"}:
            _add(candidates, "obdonuds")
            warnings.append("Only selected 2024+ Volvo/Mack CARB engine families adopted OBDonUDS early; VIN/engine certification required.")
        warnings.append("Commercial J1939/WWH-OBD depends on engine certification, region and vehicle OEM.")
    elif fuel in {"electric", "battery-electric", "bev", "ev"}:
        _add(candidates, "uds_on_can", "uds_on_doip")
        warnings.append("A BEV may not expose combustion-emissions OBD PIDs; OEM diagnostics are separate.")
    elif market in {"US", "USA", "CA", "CANADA"} and year >= 2008:
        _add(candidates, "iso15765_4_can11_500", "iso15765_4_can29_500")
        warnings.append("CAN-based emissions OBD is expected for covered 2008+ US vehicles; CAN ID format must be detected.")
        warnings.append("OBDonUDS availability cannot be determined from a passenger-vehicle year alone.")
    elif market in {"EU", "EEA", "UK"} and year >= 2008:
        _add(candidates, "iso15765_4_can11_500", "iso15765_4_can29_500",
             "iso15765_4_can11_250", "iso15765_4_can29_250",
             "iso9141_2", "iso14230_4_slow", "iso14230_4_fast")
        warnings.append("CAN is likely in 2008+ European passenger cars, but legacy EOBD K-Line remains a candidate until measured.")
        warnings.append("European EOBD regulation, fuel and registration categories vary; certification market is not owner's location.")
    elif year >= 2008:
        _add(candidates, "iso15765_4_can11_500", "iso15765_4_can29_500",
             "iso15765_4_can11_250", "iso15765_4_can29_250",
             "iso14230_4_fast", "iso9141_2")
        warnings.append("No OBD legal applicability can be assumed for an unspecified market.")
    elif year >= 1996:
        if market in {"US", "USA", "CA", "CANADA"} and make in {
            "ford", "lincoln", "mercury",
        }:
            _add(candidates, "j1850_pwm")
        elif market in {"US", "USA", "CA", "CANADA"} and make in {
            "chevrolet", "gmc", "buick", "cadillac", "pontiac", "oldsmobile",
        }:
            _add(candidates, "j1850_vpw")
        _add(candidates, "iso9141_2", "iso14230_4_slow", "iso14230_4_fast",
             "j1850_pwm", "j1850_vpw")
        if year >= 2003:
            _add(candidates, "iso15765_4_can11_500", "iso15765_4_can29_500")
        warnings.append("1996–2007 OBD interfaces may use J1850, K-Line, or later CAN; manufacturer is only a weak heuristic.")
    else:
        warnings.append("Pre-1996 standardized OBD-II is not assured. No universal connector or protocol can be inferred; inspect OEM documentation.")
    detected = read_elm_detected_protocol(detected_elm) if detected_elm is not None else None
    return {
        "year": year, "market": market.lower(), "vehicle_class": vehicle_class,
        "fuel": fuel, "make": make,
        "detection_command": "ATSP0",  # ELM auto mode (not a scan executed by this API).
        "readback_command": "ATDPN",
        "candidates": [
            {"id": id, "standard": BY_ID[id].standard, "support": BY_ID[id].support}
            for id in candidates
        ],
        "detected": detected,
        "oem_diagnostics": oem_diagnostic_hints(make),
        "verified_obd_support": False,
        "confidence": "adapter_reported" if detected and detected["protocol_id"] else "unverified_hint",
        "evidence_source": "market/year/class heuristic; adapter readback if supplied",
        "warnings": warnings,
        "notice": CANDIDATE_NOTICE,
    }

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ProtocolTraceEvent:
    event_id: UUID = field(default_factory=uuid4)
    session_id: UUID | None = None
    timestamp_ns: int = field(default_factory=time_ns)
    direction: str = 'RX'
    protocol: str = 'CAN'
    arbitration_id: int | None = None
    data: bytes = b''
    is_extended: bool = False
    is_fd: bool = False
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        value = asdict(self)
        value['event_id'] = str(self.event_id)
        value['session_id'] = str(self.session_id) if self.session_id else None
        value['data_hex'] = self.data.hex()
        del value['data']
        return value


class ProtocolTraceRecorder:
    """In-memory protocol trace with deterministic JSON export.

    The recorder captures transport-level frames; it deliberately does not
    expose ECU programming/write operations as part of Phase 16.
    """

    def __init__(self, *, session_id: UUID | None = None, max_events: int = 50_000):
        if max_events < 1:
            raise ValueError('max_events must be >= 1')
        self.session_id = session_id
        self.max_events = max_events
        self._events: list[ProtocolTraceEvent] = []

    def record_can(self, direction: str, frame: CanFrame, *, metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> ProtocolTraceEvent:
        direction = direction.upper()
        if direction not in {'TX', 'RX'}:
            raise ValueError('direction must be TX or RX')
        event = ProtocolTraceEvent(
            session_id=self.session_id,
            timestamp_ns=frame.timestamp_ns or time_ns(),
            direction=direction,
            protocol='CAN_FD' if frame.is_fd else 'CAN',
            arbitration_id=frame.arbitration_id,
            data=bytes(frame.data),
            is_extended=frame.is_extended,
            is_fd=frame.is_fd,
            metadata=metadata or {},
        )
        self._events.append(event)
        if len(self._events) > self.max_events:
            del self._events[: len(self._events) - self.max_events]
        return event

    def snapshot(self, limit: int | None = None) -> list[ProtocolTraceEvent]:
        if limit is None:
            return list(self._events)
        if limit < 0:
            raise ValueError('limit must be >= 0')
        return list(self._events[-limit:]) if limit else []

    def clear(self) -> None:
        self._events.clear()

    def export_jsonl(self, path: str | Path) -> int:
        path = Path(path)
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        body = ''.join(json.dumps(e.to_dict(), sort_keys=True) + '\n' for e in self._events)
        path.write_text(body, encoding='utf-8')
        return len(self._events)


class TracedCanBus:
    """Duck-typed CAN bus wrapper that records every frame crossing the bus."""

    def __init__(self, bus, recorder: ProtocolTraceRecorder):
        self.bus = bus
        self.recorder = recorder

    async def send(self, frame: CanFrame) -> None:
        self.recorder.record_can('TX', frame)
        await self.bus.send(frame)

    async def receive(self, timeout_ms: int = 1000) -> CanFrame | None:
        frame = await self.bus.receive(timeout_ms)
        if frame is not None:
            self.recorder.record_can('RX', frame)
        return frame

from __future__ import annotations
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class UdsDtcRecord:
    raw_dtc: int
    code: str
    status_byte: int

    @property
    def confirmed(self) -> bool:
        # ISO 14229 DTC status bit 3 is confirmedDTC. Bit 0 only says
        # testFailed and must not be presented as a confirmed DTC.
        return bool(self.status_byte & 0x08)


def format_uds_dtc(raw_dtc: int) -> str:
    if not 0 <= raw_dtc <= 0xFFFFFF:
        raise ValueError('raw_dtc must fit uint24')
    b0 = (raw_dtc >> 16) & 0xFF
    b1 = (raw_dtc >> 8) & 0xFF
    b2 = raw_dtc & 0xFF
    prefix = ('P', 'C', 'B', 'U')[(b0 >> 6) & 0x03]
    return f'{prefix}{(b0 >> 4) & 0x03}{b0 & 0x0F:X}{b1:02X}{b2:02X}'


def parse_dtc_information(payload: bytes) -> list[UdsDtcRecord]:
    """Decode UDS ReadDTCInformation positive-response payload.

    ``payload`` is the bytes after service ID 0x59. For subfunction 0x02,
    the first byte is the subfunction and the second byte is normally the
    DTCStatusAvailabilityMask, followed by 4-byte DTC/status records.
    Unknown layouts remain represented as raw records only when a complete
    4-byte record is present.
    """
    if not payload:
        return []
    if payload[0] not in range(0x01, 0x20):
        raise ValueError('malformed UDS DTC information response')
    body = payload[2:] if len(payload) >= 2 else b''
    out: list[UdsDtcRecord] = []
    for offset in range(0, len(body) - 3, 4):
        raw = int.from_bytes(body[offset:offset + 3], 'big')
        status = body[offset + 3]
        out.append(UdsDtcRecord(raw_dtc=raw, code=format_uds_dtc(raw), status_byte=status))
    return out

def _font():
    for path in (Path("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"),
                 Path("C:/Windows/Fonts/arial.ttf")):
        if path.exists():
            pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont("DemoUILatin", str(path)))
            return "DemoUILatin"
    return "Helvetica"


def _draw_screenshot(canvas, filename, x, y, w, h):
    path = SCREENSHOTS / filename
    if not path.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError("Missing checked-in Compose screenshot: " + str(path))
    canvas.setFillColor(HexColor("#0A1B2C"))
    canvas.setStrokeColor(HexColor("#1784B4"))
    canvas.roundRect(x, y, w, h, 11, fill=1, stroke=1)
    with Image.open(path) as src:
        if min(src.size) <= 0:
            raise ValueError("Invalid screenshot: " + filename)
        image = ImageReader(src.convert("RGB"))
        size = min((w-18)/src.width, (h-18)/src.height)
        iw, ih = src.width*size, src.height*size
        canvas.drawImage(image, x+(w-iw)/2, y+(h-ih)/2,
                         iw, ih, preserveAspectRatio=True)


def _appendix(width, height):
    output = BytesIO()
    canvas = Canvas(output, pagesize=(width, height), pageCompression=1)
    font = _font()
    margin = width*0.045
    gap = width*0.023
    half = (width - 2*margin - gap)/2
    bottom = height*0.14
    shot_h = height*0.59
    if half < 100 or shot_h < 100:
        raise ValueError("Unexpected original PDF page dimensions")
    for i, (title, subtitle, left, right) in enumerate(GALLERIES, 1):
        canvas.setFillColor(HexColor("#030C18"))
        canvas.rect(0, 0, width, height, fill=1, stroke=0)
        canvas.setFillColor(HexColor("#00AEEF"))
        canvas.rect(0, height-height*.007, width, height*.007, fill=1, stroke=0)
        canvas.setFont(font, max(9, min(14, width*.012)))
        canvas.setFillColor(HexColor("#35C8FF"))
        canvas.drawString(margin, height*.91, "AI CAR SCANNER / MOBILE UI")
        canvas.setFont(font, max(16, min(29, width*.025)))
        canvas.setFillColor(HexColor("#F1F7FC"))
        canvas.drawString(margin, height*.82, title)
        canvas.setFont(font, max(9, min(13, width*.012)))
        canvas.setFillColor(HexColor("#A8BED2"))
        canvas.drawString(margin, height*.76, subtitle)
        for idx, (filename, caption) in enumerate((left, right)):
            x = margin + idx*(half + gap)
            canvas.setFillColor(HexColor("#79E3FF"))
            canvas.setFont(font, max(9, min(12, width*.0105)))
            canvas.drawString(x+3, bottom+shot_h+height*.022, caption)
            _draw_screenshot(canvas, filename, x, bottom, half, shot_h)
        canvas.setFont(font, max(7, min(10, width*.0085)))
        canvas.setFillColor(HexColor("#B0C2D0"))
        canvas.drawString(margin, height*.094,
            "Actual Kotlin / Compose UI capture: API 35 Robolectric native graphics, fixture data.")
        canvas.drawString(margin, height*.061,
            "Not a physical device or emulator. Verified iOS screenshots are not available.")
        canvas.setFillColor(HexColor("#5386A1"))
        canvas.setFont(font, max(5, min(8, width*.0065)))
        canvas.drawString(margin, height*.025, MARKER)
        canvas.drawRightString(width-margin, height*.025, f"ANDROID {i}/5")
        canvas.showPage()
    canvas.save()
    output.seek(0)
    return output


def update_pdf(document=DOCUMENT):
    document = Path(document).resolve()
    if not document.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError("Original Desktop UI demo PDF does not exist: " + str(document))
    source = PdfReader(str(document))
    desktop_pages = []
    for page in source.pages:
        if MARKER in (page.extract_text() or ""):
            break
        desktop_pages.append(page)
    if len(desktop_pages) < 1:
        raise RuntimeError("Refusing to replace PDF without original Desktop pages")
    original_size = desktop_pages[0].mediabox
    appendix = PdfReader(_appendix(float(original_size.width), float(original_size.height)))
    writer = PdfWriter()
    for page in desktop_pages:
        writer.add_page(page)
    for page in appendix.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)
    writer.add_metadata({
        "/Title": "AI CAR SCANNER - Desktop and Android UI Demo",
        "/Subject": "Original Desktop demo followed by authentic Android Compose UI captures",
    })
    temp = document.with_name(document.stem + ".building.pdf")
    try:
        with temp.open("wb") as output:
            writer.write(output)
        check = PdfReader(str(temp))
        if len(check.pages) != len(desktop_pages)+len(GALLERIES):
            raise RuntimeError("PDF page count changed unexpectedly")
        if MARKER not in (check.pages[-1].extract_text() or ""):
            raise RuntimeError("Android appendix provenance verification failed")
        os.replace(temp, document)
    finally:
        if temp.exists():
            temp.unlink()
    print(f"Updated PDF: {len(desktop_pages)} Desktop pages + {len(GALLERIES)} Android pages")
    print(document)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    update_pdf()

"""Phase 4 Desktop latency/stability measurement (offline, non-destructive).

Samples real PySide6 navigation and Qt event-loop scheduling with mocked API
and storage. Optionally runs an actual frozen Windows EXE multiple times using
the existing mock-backend smoke contract. Emits machine-readable evidence.

Usage:
    python scripts/benchmark_desktop.py
    python scripts/benchmark_desktop.py --exe dist-release/icon-preview/AICarScanner.exe --exe-runs 3
    python scripts/benchmark_desktop.py --max-navigation-p95-ms 150 --max-qt-p95-ms 100

WARNING: offscreen PySide6 timing is NOT visible FPS or GPU rendering speed.
Python tracemalloc does NOT account for Qt/C++ allocations/native process RSS.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import gc
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import tracemalloc
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
# Executing `python scripts/benchmark_desktop.py` puts scripts/, not the
# repository root, at sys.path[0]. Make apps.desktop importable explicitly.
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))


def percentile(values: list[float], target: float) -> float:
    if not values:
        raise ValueError("Performance sample set must not be empty")
    ordered = sorted(values)
    rank = (len(ordered) - 1) * target / 100.0
    low = int(rank)
    high = min(low + 1, len(ordered) - 1)
    fraction = rank - low
    return ordered[low] * (1.0 - fraction) + ordered[high] * fraction


def describe_ms(values: list[float]) -> dict[str, float | int]:
    return {
        "samples": len(values),
        "mean_ms": round(statistics.fmean(values), 3),
        "p50_ms": round(percentile(values, 50), 3),
        "p95_ms": round(percentile(values, 95), 3),
        "max_ms": round(max(values), 3),
    }


def benchmark_qt_source(iterations: int) -> dict:
    # Avoid global Qt environment changes in users' regular Desktop launch.
    os.environ["QT_QPA_PLATFORM"] = "offscreen"
    os.environ["QT_STYLE_OVERRIDE"] = "Fusion"
    os.environ["AI_CAR_DISABLE_LLM_AUTOSTART"] = "1"
    from PySide6.QtCore import QEventLoop, QTimer, QCoreApplication, QEvent
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
    from apps.desktop import ui

    class EphemeralSettings:
        def __init__(self, *_args):
            pass

        def value(self, _name, default=None, type=None):
            return default
        def setValue(self, *_args):
            pass

    class EmptyStore:
        def load(self):
            return []
        def save(self, _profiles):
            raise AssertionError("Benchmark must never write real vehicle profiles")

    class NoNetworkAPI:
        base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:9"  # Inert metadata; no vehicle triggers portrait loading.
        def __getattr__(self, name):
            raise AssertionError(f"Benchmark must never access backend API: {name}")

    app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])
    with (
        patch.object(ui, "QSettings", EphemeralSettings),
        patch.object(ui, "VehicleStore", EmptyStore),
        patch.object(ui, "DiagnosticApiClient", NoNetworkAPI),
        patch.object(ui.MainWindow, "refresh_all", lambda self: None),
    ):
        # Exclude module-import/cold setup from the navigation/loop measurements;
        # report the actual window-construction time separately.
        gc.collect()
        tracemalloc.start()
        start_py_bytes, _ = tracemalloc.get_traced_memory()
        startup = time.perf_counter()
        window = ui.MainWindow()
        window.show()
        app.processEvents()
        startup_ms = (time.perf_counter() - startup) * 1000

        nav_samples: list[float] = []
        timer_samples: list[float] = []
        try:
            for cycle in range(iterations):
                before = time.perf_counter()
                window.navigate_page(cycle % len(window.pages))
                app.processEvents()
                nav_samples.append((time.perf_counter() - before) * 1000)

                loop = QEventLoop()
                before = time.perf_counter()
                QTimer.singleShot(0, loop.quit)
                loop.exec()
                timer_samples.append((time.perf_counter() - before) * 1000)
            gc.collect()
            finish_py_bytes, peak_py_bytes = tracemalloc.get_traced_memory()
        finally:
            window.close()
            window.deleteLater()
            app.processEvents()
            QCoreApplication.sendPostedEvents(None, QEvent.Type.DeferredDelete)
            app.processEvents()
            tracemalloc.stop()

    return {
        "mode": "source-offscreen-no-network",
        "window_startup_ms": round(startup_ms, 3),
        "navigation_latency": describe_ms(nav_samples),
        "qt_timer_turnaround": describe_ms(timer_samples),
        "python_allocated_growth_kib": round((finish_py_bytes - start_py_bytes) / 1024, 3),
        "python_tracemalloc_peak_kib": round(peak_py_bytes / 1024, 3),
        "limitations": (
            "Qt offscreen; no rendering FPS or GPU measurement. "
            "tracemalloc excludes native Qt/C++ memory."
        ),
    }


def benchmark_exe(exe: str, runs: int, reports: Path) -> dict:
    if sys.platform != "win32":
        raise RuntimeError("Frozen EXE stability sampling requires Windows")
    full_exe = (ROOT / exe).resolve()
    if not full_exe.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Frozen Windows GUI EXE not found: {full_exe}")
    results = []
    for index in range(runs):
        test_reports = reports / "packaged-stability" / f"run-{index+1:02}"
        command = [
            sys.executable, str(ROOT / "scripts" / "smoke_test_desktop_exe.py"),
            "--exe", str(full_exe), "--reports-dir", str(test_reports),
            "--timeout", "60", "--auto-close-ms", "1600",
        ]
        completed = subprocess.run(
            command, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=85,
            env={**os.environ, "AI_CAR_DISABLE_LLM_AUTOSTART": "1"},
        )
        report_path = test_reports / "packaged-baseline-result.json"
        report = json.loads(report_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if report_path.is_file() else {
            "status": "FAIL", "returncode": completed.returncode,
            "error": completed.stderr[-2000:],
        }
        results.append(report)
        print(f"[DESKTOP-PERF] Frozen repeat {index+1}/{runs}: "
              f"{report['status']} exit={report.get('returncode')}", flush=True)
    passing = all(x.get("status") == "PASS" and x.get("returncode") == 0 for x in results)
    durations = [x["elapsed_seconds"] * 1000 for x in results if "elapsed_seconds" in x]
    return {
        "status": "PASS" if passing else "FAIL",
        "repetitions": runs,
        "passed": sum(x.get("status") == "PASS" and x.get("returncode") == 0 for x in results),
        "startup_to_close_elapsed_ms": describe_ms(durations) if durations else None,
        "samples": results,
    }


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--iterations", type=int, default=70)
    parser.add_argument("--exe", default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--exe-runs", type=int, default=3)
    parser.add_argument("--max-navigation-p95-ms", type=float, default=0.0)
    parser.add_argument("--max-qt-p95-ms", type=float, default=0.0)
    parser.add_argument("--reports-dir", default="desktop-test-reports")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.iterations < 10 or args.exe_runs < 1:
        parser.error("At least 10 navigation iterations and 1 EXE run are required")
    if args.max_navigation_p95_ms < 0 or args.max_qt_p95_ms < 0:
        parser.error("Performance gates must be nonnegative; zero disables a gate")
    if args.exe_runs > 25:
        parser.error("Maximum EXE stability runs per invocation is 25")

    reports = (ROOT / args.reports_dir).resolve()
    reports.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    result = {
        "status": "MEASURED",
        "performance_budget_ms": {
            "navigation_p95": args.max_navigation_p95_ms,
            "qt_timer_p95": args.max_qt_p95_ms,
        },
        "source_qt": benchmark_qt_source(args.iterations),
        "packaged_exe": None,
        "violations": [],
    }
    nav = result["source_qt"]["navigation_latency"]["p95_ms"]
    qt = result["source_qt"]["qt_timer_turnaround"]["p95_ms"]
    if args.max_navigation_p95_ms and nav > args.max_navigation_p95_ms:
        result["violations"].append(f"navigation p95 {nav}ms > {args.max_navigation_p95_ms}ms")
    if args.max_qt_p95_ms and qt > args.max_qt_p95_ms:
        result["violations"].append(f"Qt event-loop p95 {qt}ms > {args.max_qt_p95_ms}ms")

    if args.exe:
        result["packaged_exe"] = benchmark_exe(args.exe, args.exe_runs, reports)
        if result["packaged_exe"]["status"] != "PASS":
            result["violations"].append("Frozen Windows EXE did not exit 0 in every repeat")

    has_gate = bool(
        args.max_navigation_p95_ms or args.max_qt_p95_ms or args.exe
    )
    if result["violations"]:
        result["status"] = "FAIL"
    elif has_gate:
        result["status"] = "PASS"
    # Without any explicit budget or frozen-EXE checks, report MEASURED,
    # not PASS. A successful benchmark invocation is not an SLA verdict.
    path = reports / "performance.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"[DESKTOP-PERF] Qt navigation p95: {nav}ms, event-loop p95: {qt}ms")
    print(f"[DESKTOP-PERF] {result['status']} | evidence: {path}")
    for error in result["violations"]:
        print(f"[DESKTOP-PERF] FAIL: {error}")
    return 1 if result["violations"] else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Explicit experiment: compare Python exact mean, fmean, and C ABI including copies.
Build the shared library separately; application runtime has no native dependency.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import ctypes
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import statistics
from benchmark_pipeline import fixture, measure
from telemetry import analysis


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--library',type=Path,required=True);parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True);args=parser.parse_args()
    lib=ctypes.CDLL(str(args.library.resolve()))
    lib.telemetry_mean.argtypes=[ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double),ctypes.c_size_t,ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)]
    lib.telemetry_mean.restype=ctypes.c_int
    def native(values):
        packed=(ctypes.c_double*len(values))(*values)
        out=ctypes.c_double();status=lib.telemetry_mean(packed,len(values),ctypes.byref(out))
        if status:raise ValueError(f'native mean status {status}')
        return out.value
    service,sid=fixture(10000);exact=analysis.mean
    base=service.summarize(sid).model_dump(mode='json')
    results={}
    try:
        for name,fn in [('python_exact_mean',statistics.mean),('python_fmean_experiment',statistics.fmean),('cpp_copy_included_experiment',native)]:
            analysis.mean=fn
            actual=service.summarize(sid).model_dump(mode='json')
            errors=[]
            for left,right in zip(base['stats'],actual['stats']):
                for key in ('mean','mean_abs_delta','stddev'):
                    assert math.isclose(left[key],right[key],rel_tol=1e-12,abs_tol=1e-12)
                    errors.append(abs(left[key]-right[key]))
            results[name]={'pipeline':measure(lambda:service.summarize(sid),40),
                'max_absolute_numeric_difference':max(errors),'tolerance_check':'PASS (fixture only; not exact equivalence)'}
        values=[float(i)/7 for i in range(2500)]
        packed=(ctypes.c_double*len(values))(*values);out=ctypes.c_double()
        results['native_prepacked_micro_only']=measure(lambda:lib.telemetry_mean(packed,len(values),ctypes.byref(out)),1000)
        results['native_mean_with_copy_micro']=measure(lambda:native(values),1000)
        results['python_fmean_micro']=measure(lambda:statistics.fmean(values),1000)
        results['python_exact_mean_micro']=measure(lambda:statistics.mean(values),1000)
    finally:analysis.mean=exact
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps({'results':results,'decision':'NOT INTEGRATED: finite-only contract, floating-point equivalence not universal; compare simpler fmean first. GIL release only during ctypes call, packing holds GIL. No JNI/iOS/Windows validation.'},indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')

if __name__=='__main__':main()

def fixture(count):
    rng = random.Random(429)
    sid = UUID(int=42)
    samples = [TelemetrySample(session_id=sid, timestamp_ms=(i // 4)*100,
        pid=('rpm','coolant_temp','vehicle_speed','map')[i % 4],
        value=(750,95,40,32)[i % 4] + rng.random(), sequence=i,
        quality='INVALID' if i % 101 == 0 else 'GOOD') for i in range(count)]
    rng.shuffle(samples)
    service = TelemetryService()
    service.append(samples)
    return service, sid


def measure(fn, iterations, warmups=5):
    for _ in range(warmups): fn()
    gc.collect()
    times = []
    cpu = time.process_time()
    wall = time.perf_counter()
    for _ in range(iterations):
        start = time.perf_counter_ns(); fn(); times.append((time.perf_counter_ns()-start)/1e6)
    elapsed = time.perf_counter()-wall
    cpu = time.process_time()-cpu
    ordered = sorted(times)
    tracemalloc.start(); fn(); current, peak = tracemalloc.get_traced_memory(); tracemalloc.stop()
    return {'iterations':iterations,'warmups':warmups,'p50_ms':statistics.median(times),
        'p95_ms':ordered[math.ceil(.95*len(times))-1], 'p99_ms':ordered[math.ceil(.99*len(times))-1],
        'operations_per_second':iterations/elapsed, 'cpu_seconds':cpu, 'wall_seconds':elapsed,
        'cpu_percent_one_core':100*cpu/elapsed,'traced_peak_bytes':peak,
        'allocation_count':'NOT MEASURED','gc_counts_after':gc.get_count()}

"""Prepare and compile a pinned Windows installer; never publishes a release."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
SOURCE = ROOT / 'finalbuild/installer/windows'


def compiler(explicit=None):
    candidates = [explicit, shutil.which('ISCC.exe')]
    for environment in ('ProgramFiles(x86)', 'ProgramFiles', 'LOCALAPPDATA'):
        if os.environ.get(environment):
            base = Path(os.environ[environment])
            candidates += [base / 'Inno Setup 6/ISCC.exe', base / 'Programs/Inno Setup 6/ISCC.exe']
    return next((Path(p).resolve() for p in candidates if p and Path(p).is_file()), None)


def export_snapshot(commit, destination):
    # Archive tracked files from the selected commit, never .git, local ENV,
    # venvs, credentials or other untracked files from the developer's clone.
    subprocess.run(['git', 'archive', '--format=zip', '--prefix=AI-CAR-SCANER-' + commit + '/',
                    '--output=' + str(destination), commit], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
    with destination.open('rb') as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()


def prepare(output, commit, *, online_only=False):
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', commit):
        raise ValueError('Use a full 40-character commit SHA; branch names are not pinned installers')
    payload = output / 'payload'
    payload.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for name in ('bootstrap.ps1', 'windows_installer.py', 'AI-Car-Scanner.iss', 'wizard-side.bmp', 'wizard-icon.bmp'):
        shutil.copy2(SOURCE / name, payload / name)
    shutil.copy2(ROOT / 'finalbuild/assets/AI-Car-Scanner.ico', payload / 'app.ico')
    for role in ('user', 'customer', 'market'):
        shutil.copy2(ROOT / f'finalbuild/assets/app_icons/{role}/icon.ico', payload / f'product-{role}.ico')
    manifest = {'repository': 'Grigor1995/AI-CAR-SCANER', 'commit': commit,
                'source_mode': 'online' if online_only else 'bundled'}
    archive = payload / 'source.zip'
    if online_only:
        # Do not accidentally ship an older bundled snapshot on a later build.
        archive.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    else:
        manifest['source_sha256'] = export_snapshot(commit, archive)
    (payload / 'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    return payload


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--iscc', type=Path, help='Inno Setup 6.3+ ISCC.exe')
    parser.add_argument('--commit', help='Commit available locally, default: HEAD; online-only mode requires public GitHub access')
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, default=ROOT / 'artifacts/windows-installer')
    parser.add_argument('--online-only', action='store_true', help='Download public GitHub source at install time instead of bundling the tracked snapshot')
    parser.add_argument('--prepare-only', action='store_true', help='Prepare inspectable payload without a Windows compiler')
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        commit = args.commit or subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip()
        iscc = compiler(args.iscc)
        if not args.prepare_only and platform.system() != 'Windows':
            raise ValueError('Compile Setup.exe on Windows; use --prepare-only to inspect the payload here')
        if not args.prepare_only and iscc is None:
            raise ValueError('Install Inno Setup 6.3+ from https://jrsoftware.org/isdl.php or pass --iscc "C:\\path\\ISCC.exe"')
        output = args.output.resolve()
        payload = prepare(output, commit, online_only=args.online_only)
        print(f'[INSTALLER] Pinned source: {commit}\n[INSTALLER] Payload: {payload}')
        if args.prepare_only:
            return 0
        destination = output / 'dist'
        destination.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        subprocess.run([str(iscc), '/DPayloadDir=' + str(payload), '/DOutputDir=' + str(destination),
                        '/DAppVersion=1.0-' + commit[:8], str(payload / 'AI-Car-Scanner.iss')], check=True)
        artifact = destination / 'AI-Car-Scanner-Setup.exe'
        if not artifact.is_file() or artifact.stat().st_size == 0:
            raise ValueError('Compiler returned without a Setup executable')
        with artifact.open('rb') as stream:
            digest = hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()
        artifact.with_suffix('.exe.sha256').write_text(digest + '  ' + artifact.name + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
        print(f'[READY] {artifact}\n[SHA256] {digest}')
        return 0
    except (OSError, ValueError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
        print('[INSTALLER ERROR] ' + str(error), file=sys.stderr)
        return 1


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Two real processes + temporary SQL: remote catalog failure never disables identity."""
from pathlib import Path
import json
import os
import secrets
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from urllib.error import HTTPError
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
P='/api/v2/ecosystem'

def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));return sock.getsockname()[1]

def http(base,path,method='GET',data=None,token=None):
    headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Correlation-ID':'qa-remote-catalog'}
    if token:headers['Authorization']='Bearer '+token
    req=Request(base+path,method=method,headers=headers,data=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None)
    try:response=urlopen(req,timeout=5)
    except HTTPError as error:response=error
    with response:
        payload=response.read()
        return response.status,json.loads(payload) if payload else None,response.headers

def stop(process):
    if process is not None and process.poll() is None:
        process.terminate()
        try:process.wait(timeout=10)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:process.kill();process.wait(timeout=5)

def ready(process,base):
    deadline=time.monotonic()+30
    while time.monotonic()<deadline:
        if process.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError('Isolated service exited before readiness')
        try:
            if http(base,'/health')[0]==200:return
        except OSError:pass
        time.sleep(.05)
    raise RuntimeError('Isolated service startup timeout')

def main():
    checks={};backend=None;catalog=None
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='ai-car-catalog-smoke-') as directory:
        folder=Path(directory);token=secrets.token_urlsafe(48)
        backend_port,catalog_port=free_port(),free_port()
        base=f'http://127.0.0.1:{backend_port}';catalog_base=f'http://127.0.0.1:{catalog_port}'
        env={**os.environ,'DATABASE_URL':'sqlite:///'+(folder/'business.sqlite').as_posix(),
             'AI_CAR_ECOSYSTEM_ENABLED':'1','AI_CAR_CATALOG_MODE':'remote','AI_CAR_CATALOG_URL':catalog_base,
             'AI_CAR_VEHICLE_SERVICE_TOKEN':token,'AI_CAR_CONFIG_ENV':'testing','AI_CAR_BACKEND_PORT':str(backend_port),
             'AI_CAR_DISABLE_LLM_AUTOSTART':'1','PYTHONUTF8':'1'}
        env.pop('AI_CAR_ENV_CONFIG',None)
        command=[sys.executable,'-m','backend.main','--migrate','--port',str(backend_port)]
        with (folder/'processes.log').open('w',encoding='utf-8') as log:
            try:
                catalog=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-m','backend.services.vehicle_catalog','--port',str(catalog_port)],
                    cwd=ROOT/'finalbuild',env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
                ready(catalog,catalog_base)
                backend=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=ROOT/'finalbuild',env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
                ready(backend,base)
                checks['independent_services_started']=True
                checks['catalog_authentication']=http(catalog_base,'/ready')[0]==401
                checks['catalog_readiness']=http(catalog_base,'/ready',token=token)[0]==200
                checks['gateway_requires_account']=http(base,P+'/catalog/makes')[0]==401
                account={'email':'catalog-smoke@example.invalid','full_name':'Catalog smoke','password':'local-smoke-passphrase-123'}
                assert http(base,P+'/accounts','POST',account)[0]==201
                code,login,_=http(base,P+'/auth/login','POST',{'email':account['email'],'password':account['password']})
                assert code==200;bearer=login['access_token']
                for operation,query in [('stats',''),('makes','?q=BMW'),('models','?make=BMW&year=2013'),
                                        ('fitments','?make=BMW&model=3%20Series&year=2013'),
                                        ('profile','?make=BMW&model=3%20Series&year=2013')]:
                    status,payload,headers=http(base,P+'/catalog/'+operation+query,token=bearer)
                    checks['gateway_remote_'+operation]=status==200 and bool(payload)
                    assert headers['X-Correlation-ID']=='qa-remote-catalog'
                stop(catalog)
                checks['catalog_failure_is_503']=http(base,P+'/catalog/stats',token=bearer)[0]==503
                checks['identity_survives_catalog_failure']=http(base,P+'/me',token=bearer)[0]==200
                stop(backend);env['AI_CAR_CATALOG_MODE']='embedded'
                backend=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=ROOT/'finalbuild',env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
                ready(backend,base)
                checks['rollback_embedded_preserves_account']=http(base,P+'/me',token=bearer)[0]==200
                checks['rollback_embedded_restores_catalog']=http(base,P+'/catalog/makes?q=BMW',token=bearer)[1]==['BMW']
                assert all(checks.values()),'Catalog gateway smoke check failed'
            finally:stop(backend);stop(catalog)
    evidence={'result':'PASS','checks':checks,'execution':'Two independent Python processes; real HTTP + temporary Alembic SQLite; no hardware/providers'}
    (ROOT/'docs/evidence/catalog-gateway-smoke.json').write_text(json.dumps(evidence,indent=2)+'\n')
    print('PASS: '+', '.join(checks))

if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Migrate and exercise a temporary local v2 server; never use operator data."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
PREFIX = '/api/v2/ecosystem'


def main():
    checks = {}
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='ai-car-ecosystem-') as directory:
        temporary = Path(directory)
        with socket.socket() as sock:
            sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
            port = sock.getsockname()[1]
        env = os.environ.copy()
        env.update(DATABASE_URL='sqlite:///' + (temporary/'smoke.sqlite').as_posix(),
                   AI_CAR_ECOSYSTEM_ENABLED='1', AI_CAR_BACKEND_HOST='127.0.0.1', AI_CAR_BACKEND_PORT=str(port),
                   AI_CAR_DISABLE_LLM_AUTOSTART='1', PYTHONUTF8='1', PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8')
        # Do not let an operator's JSON config change this isolated smoke database.
        env.pop('AI_CAR_ENV_CONFIG', None)
        subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'alembic', '-c', str(ROOT/'finalbuild/backend/alembic.ini'), 'upgrade', 'head'],
                       cwd=ROOT, env=env, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
        checks['explicit_alembic_upgrade'] = True
        base = f'http://127.0.0.1:{port}'

        def request(path, method='GET', data=None, token=None):
            headers = {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
            if token: headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer ' + token
            req = urllib.request.Request(base+path, headers=headers, method=method,
                                         data=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None)
            try:
                response = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10)
            except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
                response = error
            with response:
                raw = response.read()
                return response.code, json.loads(raw) if raw else None

        output = (temporary/'server.log').open('a', encoding='utf-8')
        process = None
        def start():
            nonlocal process
            process = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-m', 'backend.main'], cwd=ROOT/'finalbuild',
                                       env=env, stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
            deadline = time.monotonic()+30
            while time.monotonic() < deadline:
                if process.poll() is not None: raise RuntimeError('Smoke server failed to start')
                try:
                    if request('/health')[0] == 200: return
                except (OSError, ValueError):
                    pass
                time.sleep(.1)
            raise RuntimeError('Smoke server startup deadline exceeded')

        def stop():
            if process is not None and process.poll() is None:
                process.terminate()
                try: process.wait(timeout=10)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    process.kill(); process.wait(timeout=5)

        def user(name):
            payload = dict(email=name+'@example.invalid', full_name=name, password='local-smoke-passphrase-123')
            status, body = request(PREFIX+'/accounts', 'POST', payload)
            assert status == 201, 'Account registration failed'
            status, login = request(PREFIX+'/auth/login', 'POST', {'email':payload['email'], 'password':payload['password']})
            assert status == 200, 'Login failed'
            return body['id'], login['access_token']

        try:
            start()
            owner, token = user('owner')
            _, mechanic = user('mechanic')
            _, merchant_token = user('merchant')
            status, profile = request(PREFIX+'/vehicles', 'POST', {'vehicle': {'make':'Mercedes-Benz','model':'E-Class','chassis':'W211'}}, token)
            assert status == 201
            vehicle_id = profile['id']
            status, center = request(PREFIX+'/service-centers','POST',{'name':'Smoke workshop','address':'Test address'},mechanic)
            assert status == 201
            center_id = center['id']
            status, _ = request(PREFIX+'/merchants','POST',{'name':'Smoke merchant','address':'Test address'},merchant_token)
            checks['market_business_onboarding'] = status == 201
            for role, bearer_token in [('USER',token),('CUSTOMER',mechanic),('MARKET',merchant_token)]:
                status, nav = request(PREFIX+'/navigation?workspace='+role,token=bearer_token)
                checks['separate_'+role.lower()+'_workspace'] = status == 200 and nav['workspace'] == role
            checks['market_has_no_customer_privilege'] = request(PREFIX+'/navigation?workspace=CUSTOMER',token=merchant_token)[0] == 403
            status, invite = request(PREFIX+f'/service-centers/{center_id}/invitations','POST',{'account_id':owner},mechanic)
            assert status == 201
            shared_path = PREFIX+f'/service-centers/{center_id}/vehicles/{vehicle_id}'
            status, inbox = request(PREFIX+'/invitations', token=token)
            checks['owner_can_identify_inviter'] = status == 200 and inbox[0]['center_name'] == 'Smoke workshop' and inbox[0]['center_verified'] is False
            checks['workshop_membership_discoverable'] = request(PREFIX+'/service-centers', token=mechanic)[1][0]['id'] == center_id
            checks['invitation_alone_denied'] = request(shared_path, token=mechanic)[0] == 404
            status, grant = request(PREFIX+f'/invitations/{invite["id"]}/accept','POST',{'profile_id':vehicle_id},token)
            checks['owner_accepts'] = status == 200
            checks['approved_scoped_read'] = request(shared_path,token=mechanic)[0] == 200
            checks['legacy_bypass_denied'] = request('/api/v1/vehicle-profiles',token=token)[0] == 403
            assert request(PREFIX+f'/consents/{grant["id"]}','DELETE',token=token)[0] == 204
            checks['revoked_read_denied'] = request(shared_path,token=mechanic)[0] == 404
            status, diagnostic = request(PREFIX+'/diagnostics','POST',{'profile_id':vehicle_id},token)
            checks['owned_diagnostic_created'] = status == 201
            diagnostic_id = diagnostic['id']
            status, analyzed = request(PREFIX+f'/diagnostics/{diagnostic_id}/analyze','POST',{'symptom':'Engine misfires under load','dtcs':['P0302']},token)
            checks['shared_engine_analysis'] = status == 200 and bool(analyzed['hypotheses'])
            status, _ = request(PREFIX+'/settings','PUT',{'language':'fr','units':'USA'},token)
            checks['preferences_persisted'] = status == 200
            stop(); start()
            status, restored = request(PREFIX+'/me',token=token)
            checks['account_and_bearer_survive_restart'] = status == 200 and restored['id'] == owner
            checks['consent_revocation_survives_restart'] = request(shared_path,token=mechanic)[0] == 404
            checks['diagnostic_survives_restart'] = request(PREFIX+f'/diagnostics/{diagnostic_id}',token=token)[1]['session']['dtcs'][0]['code'] == 'P0302'
            checks['preferences_survive_restart'] = request(PREFIX+'/settings',token=token)[1]['language'] == 'fr'
            assert all(checks.values()), 'One or more smoke checks failed'
        finally:
            stop(); output.close()
    result = {'result':'PASS','database':'Temporary SQLite; real Alembic + Uvicorn subprocess and HTTP requests',
              'checks':checks,'external_providers':'NOT EXECUTED','real_hardware':'NOT EXECUTED'}
    destination = ROOT/'docs/evidence/foundation-http-smoke.json'
    destination.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
    print('PASS: '+', '.join(checks))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Exercise the real Desktop launcher with isolated storage and a restart.

Run from finalbuild: python scripts/check_local_backend.py
Never connects to a configured user database or requires Qt/LLM/hardware.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import socket
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import shutil
from contextlib import contextmanager

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))


@contextmanager
def check_directory():
    folder = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="ai-car-backend-check-")
    try:
        yield folder
    finally:
        # Windows virus scanners can hold a recently closed log briefly.
        # Never replace the actual check result with a cleanup traceback.
        for attempt in range(20):
            try:
                shutil.rmtree(folder)
                break
            except PermissionError:
                if attempt == 19:
                    print(f"WARNING: diagnostics retained because a file is still locked: {folder}", file=sys.stderr)
                else:
                    time.sleep(0.1)


def main():
    import requests

    with socket.socket() as listener:
        listener.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        port = listener.getsockname()[1]
    with check_directory() as folder:
        os.environ.update({
            "APPDATA": folder,
            "AI_CAR_BACKEND_HOST": "127.0.0.1",
            "AI_CAR_BACKEND_PORT": str(port),
            "AI_CAR_BACKEND_URL": f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}",
            "AI_CAR_USE_LOCAL_DATABASE": "1",
            "AI_CAR_DISABLE_LLM_AUTOSTART": "1",
        })
        from apps.desktop import main as launcher

        try:
            started = time.monotonic()
            launcher.start_backend()
            print(f"PASS: real launcher ready in {time.monotonic() - started:.2f}s")
            with requests.Session() as client:
                client.trust_env = False
                def request(method, path, **kwargs):
                    response = client.request(method, launcher.BACKEND_URL + path, timeout=10, **kwargs)
                    response.raise_for_status()
                    return response.json()

                assert request("GET", "/health")["status"] == "ok"
                catalog = request("GET", "/api/v1/vehicle-catalog/entries")
                assert catalog and all(isinstance(row["fuel"], list) for row in catalog)
                print(f"PASS: catalog contains {len(catalog)} rows with valid fuel lists")
                created = request("POST", "/api/v1/sessions", json={})
                sid = created["session_id"]
                path = f"/api/v1/sessions/{sid}"
                request("POST", path + "/symptoms", json={"raw_text": "Engine misfires on LPG; petrol runs normally"})
                request("POST", path + "/dtcs", json={"code": "P0302"})
                result = request("POST", path + "/analyze")
                assert result["hypotheses"] and result["recommendations"]
                print("PASS: session, symptoms, DTC and diagnostic analysis")
                launcher.stop_backend()
                launcher.start_backend()
                restored = request("GET", path)
                assert restored["dtcs"][0]["code"] == "P0302"
                assert restored["hypotheses"] == result["hypotheses"]
                assert len(request("GET", "/api/v1/vehicle-catalog/entries")) == len(catalog)
                print("PASS: session/analysis retained after restart; catalog unchanged")
        except Exception:
            log = Path(folder) / "AI-Car-Scanner/backend.log"
            if log.exists():
                print(log.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")[-16000:], file=sys.stderr)
            raise
        finally:
            launcher.stop_backend()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Inspect local GGUF/runtime paths and actual AI endpoints without starting UI.

Run from finalbuild: python scripts/check_offline_ai.py
No model download, API key or cloud service is required by this check.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import replace
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
from urllib.request import urlopen

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
for index, directory in enumerate((ROOT, ROOT/'backend')):
    if str(directory) not in sys.path:
        sys.path.insert(index, str(directory))


def inspect():
    import os
    from apps.desktop import main as launcher
    from ai.llm.llama_server import LlamaServerConfig, LlamaServerLLMProvider
    model = launcher._resolve_model_path()
    server = launcher._resolve_llama_server()
    config = replace(LlamaServerConfig.from_env(), base_url=launcher.LLM_BASE_URL, model=model.name)
    result = {'configured_provider':os.getenv('DIAGNOSTIC_LLM_PROVIDER','llama-server'),
              'model_path':str(model), 'model_exists':model.is_file(),
              'model_candidates':[p.name for p in (launcher.ROOT/'models').glob('*.gguf')],
              'server_binary':str(server) if server else None,
              'local_runtime':LlamaServerLLMProvider(config).availability()}
    try:
        with urlopen(launcher.BACKEND_URL+'/api/v1/ai/provider',timeout=3) as response:
            result['backend_provider'] = json.loads(response.read().decode())
    except Exception as error:
        result['backend_provider'] = {'available':False,'reason':str(error)}
    result['ready'] = bool(result['local_runtime'].get('available'))
    if not result['ready']:
        if not model.is_file():
            result['next_step'] = 'Set LOCAL_LLM_MODEL_PATH to your GGUF, or keep one model in models/.'
        elif server is None:
            result['next_step'] = 'Install llama-server with its DLLs in tools/llama.cpp/, or set LOCAL_LLM_SERVER_PATH.'
        else:
            result['next_step'] = 'Run python -m apps.desktop.main --with-backend --local-ai; inspect llama-server.log if loading fails.'
    elif (result['backend_provider'].get('provider') != 'LlamaServerLLMProvider'
          or not result['backend_provider'].get('available')):
        result['ready'] = False
        result['next_step'] = 'Close the existing backend, then launch Desktop with --with-backend --local-ai.'
    return result


def main():
    result = inspect()
    print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
    return 0 if result['ready'] else 1


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Regenerate each architecture view as Mermaid from the local interactive data."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
DIRECTORY = ROOT/'docs/architecture'


def main():
    data = json.loads((DIRECTORY/'architecture-data.js').read_text(encoding='utf-8').partition('=')[2].strip().removesuffix(';'))
    for title, ids in data['views'].items():
        selected = set(ids)
        lines = ['flowchart LR']
        for node in data['nodes']:
            if node['id'] not in selected: continue
            label = json.dumps(node['title']+' — '+node['status'], ensure_ascii=False)
            lines.append(f'  {node["id"]}[{label}]')
        for edge in data['edges']:
            if edge['source'] in selected and edge['target'] in selected:
                label = json.dumps(edge['label'], ensure_ascii=False)
                lines.append(f'  {edge["source"]} -->|{label}| {edge["target"]}')
        lines.append('  classDef planned stroke-dasharray: 5 5;')
        planned = [node['id'] for node in data['nodes'] if node['id'] in selected and node['status']=='PLANNED']
        if planned: lines.append('  class '+','.join(planned)+' planned;')
        content = '\n'.join(lines)+'\n'
        filename = re.sub('[^a-z0-9]+', '-', title.lower()).strip('-')+'.mmd'
        (DIRECTORY/filename).write_text(content,encoding='utf-8')
        if title=='High-Level Architecture': (DIRECTORY/'architecture.mmd').write_text(content,encoding='utf-8')
    print(f'Exported {len(data["views"])} Mermaid architecture views')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Export actual foundation request/response contracts without connecting to operator databases."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
PROJECT = ROOT/'finalbuild'


def main():
    # Isolate only this exporter process; never inspect a configured production DB.
    os.environ['DATABASE_URL'] = 'sqlite://'
    os.environ['AI_CAR_ECOSYSTEM_ENABLED'] = '0'
    os.environ.pop('AI_CAR_ENV_CONFIG', None)
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT))
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT/'backend'))
    from api.main import app
    source = app.openapi()
    paths = {path: body for path, body in source['paths'].items() if path.startswith('/api/v2/ecosystem/')}
    needed = set()

    def references(value):
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            if value.get('$ref', '').startswith('#/components/schemas/'):
                needed.add(value['$ref'].rsplit('/', 1)[1])
            for item in value.values(): references(item)
        elif isinstance(value, list):
            for item in value: references(item)

    references(paths)
    while True:
        previous = set(needed)
        for name in list(needed): references(source['components']['schemas'][name])
        if previous == needed: break
    output = {'openapi': source['openapi'],
              'info': {'title': 'AI Car Scanner ecosystem foundation', 'version': '0.1-foundation',
                       'description': 'Generated from implemented v2 routes; feature-gated and not a complete ecosystem.'},
              'paths': paths, 'components': {'schemas': {name: source['components']['schemas'][name] for name in sorted(needed)},
                                           'securitySchemes': source['components']['securitySchemes']}}
    target = ROOT/'docs/architecture/ecosystem-openapi.json'
    target.write_text(json.dumps(output, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
    print(f'Exported {len(paths)} foundation paths to {target}')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Technical exports of approved generated originals; no visual recoloring.

Desktop retains alpha. Android adaptive foreground uses the central safe zone.
iOS requires an opaque 1024px asset. Original generated PNGs are never mutated.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import json
from PIL import Image, ImageOps

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
ROLES = ('user', 'customer', 'market')
DENSITIES = {'mdpi': 1, 'hdpi': 1.5, 'xhdpi': 2, 'xxhdpi': 3, 'xxxhdpi': 4}

def export(root=ROOT):
    for role in ROLES:
        folder = root/'assets/app_icons'/role
        with Image.open(folder/'source.png') as source:
            image = source.convert('RGBA')
        image = ImageOps.contain(image, (1024, 1024), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
        canvas = Image.new('RGBA', (1024, 1024))
        canvas.alpha_composite(image, ((1024-image.width)//2, (1024-image.height)//2))
        canvas.save(folder/'icon.png')
        canvas.save(folder/'icon.ico', sizes=[(16,16),(24,24),(32,32),(48,48),(64,64),(128,128),(256,256)])
        android = root/'apps/mobile-android/app/src'/role/'res'
        for density, factor in DENSITIES.items():
            mipmap = android/f'mipmap-{density}'; mipmap.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            canvas.resize((int(48*factor),)*2, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS).save(mipmap/'ic_launcher.webp', lossless=True)
            drawable = android/f'drawable-{density}'; drawable.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            safe = Image.new('RGBA', (int(108*factor),)*2)
            glyph = canvas.resize((int(66*factor),)*2, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
            safe.alpha_composite(glyph, ((safe.width-glyph.width)//2,)*2)
            safe.save(drawable/'product_launcher_foreground.png')
        adaptive=android/'mipmap-anydpi-v26'; adaptive.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (adaptive/'ic_launcher.xml').write_text('''<adaptive-icon xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android">
    <background android:drawable="@color/product_launcher_background" />
    <foreground android:drawable="@drawable/product_launcher_foreground" />
</adaptive-icon>\n''')
        values=android/'values'; values.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        (values/'icon_colors.xml').write_text('<resources><color name="product_launcher_background">#061222</color></resources>\n')
        ios = root/'apps/mobile-ios/AICarScanner/Assets.xcassets'/f'AppIcon{role.title()}.appiconset'
        ios.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        opaque = Image.new('RGBA', canvas.size, '#061222'); opaque.alpha_composite(canvas)

                                                   'info':{'author':'xcode','version':1}}, indent=2)+'\n')

"""Enrich backend vehicle references with attributed Commons images.

Run from finalbuild: python scripts/import_wikimedia_vehicles.py --limit 50
Requires network access to Wikipedia/Commons and Pillow. API startup is offline.
"""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from hashlib import sha256
from io import BytesIO
import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "backend"))
from catalog_sources.wikimedia import image_metadata, fetch_image  # noqa: E402


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=50)
    parser.add_argument("--make")
    parser.add_argument("--force", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if not 1 <= args.limit <= 500:
        parser.error("limit must be between 1 and 500")
    from PIL import Image
    cars = json.loads((ROOT / "data/vehicle_reference.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["vehicles"]
    directory = ROOT / "data/vehicle_images"
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    manifest_path = directory / "manifest.json"
    manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if manifest_path.exists() else {}
    failures = []
    selected = [c for c in cars if not args.make or c["make"].casefold() == args.make.casefold()][:args.limit]
    for car in selected:
        if car["id"] in manifest and not args.force:
            continue
        try:
            metadata = image_metadata(car["wikipedia_title"])
            data = fetch_image(metadata["download_url"])
            with Image.open(BytesIO(data)) as photo:
                if photo.format not in {"JPEG", "PNG", "WEBP"} or photo.width * photo.height > 40_000_000:
                    raise ValueError("Unsupported or oversized raster photo")
                photo.thumbnail((960, 640))
                converted = BytesIO()
                photo.convert("RGB").save(converted, format="WEBP", quality=86)
            content = converted.getvalue()
            image_path = directory / (car["id"]+".webp")
            image_temp = image_path.with_suffix(".webp.tmp")
            image_temp.write_bytes(content)
            os.replace(image_temp, image_path)
            metadata.update(path=str(image_path.relative_to(ROOT)), sha256=sha256(content).hexdigest(),
                            retrieved_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
            manifest[car["id"]] = metadata
            temporary = manifest_path.with_suffix(".tmp")
            temporary.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)+"\n", encoding="utf-8")
            os.replace(temporary, manifest_path)
            print(f"IMPORTED {car['id']} — {metadata['license']}", flush=True)
        except Exception as error:
            failures.append({"id": car["id"], "error": str(error)})
            print(f"FAILED {car['id']}: {error}", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
    print(json.dumps({"selected": len(selected), "available_images": len(manifest), "failures": failures}))
    return 1 if failures else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
