"""Package the original transparent Desktop logo for all native launchers."""
from pathlib import Path
from shutil import copyfile
from PIL import Image

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def regenerate() -> None:
    source = ROOT / 'assets/AI-Car-Scanner-master.png'
    with Image.open(source) as original:
        logo = original.convert('RGBA')
    # Keep one canonical transparent logo, including the Desktop derivatives.
    for relative in ('assets/ai-car-scanner-icon.png', 'assets/launcher/mobile-app-icon.png',
                     'assets/AI-Car-Scanner-mobile.png'):
        copyfile(source, ROOT / relative)
    logo.save(ROOT / 'assets/AI-Car-Scanner.webp', lossless=True)
    logo.save(ROOT / 'assets/AI-Car-Scanner.ico', sizes=[(n, n) for n in (16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 128, 256)])
    res = ROOT / 'apps/mobile-android/app/src/main/res'
    for density, size in [('mdpi',48), ('hdpi',72), ('xhdpi',96), ('xxhdpi',144), ('xxxhdpi',192), ('',192)]:
        folder = res / ('mipmap' + (f'-{density}' if density else ''))
        logo.resize((size,size), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS).save(folder / 'ic_launcher.webp', lossless=True)
    # The adaptive XML inset supplies the safe area without flattening alpha.
    copyfile(source, res / 'drawable-nodpi/ic_launcher_foreground.png')
    # Apple requires an opaque App Store icon; preserve the same mark on black.
    ios = Image.new('RGB', (1024,1024), 'black')
    ios.paste(logo, (0,0), logo.getchannel('A'))
    ios.save(ROOT / 'apps/mobile-ios/AICarScanner/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/ai-car-scanner-icon.png')


def check() -> None:
    master = ROOT / 'assets/AI-Car-Scanner-master.png'
    with Image.open(master) as im:
        assert im.mode == 'RGBA' and im.getchannel('A').getextrema() == (0, 255)
    for relative in ('assets/AI-Car-Scanner-mobile.png', 'assets/ai-car-scanner-icon.png',
                     'assets/launcher/mobile-app-icon.png',
                     'apps/mobile-android/app/src/main/res/drawable-nodpi/ic_launcher_foreground.png'):
        assert (ROOT / relative).read_bytes() == master.read_bytes(), relative
    with Image.open(ROOT / 'apps/mobile-ios/AICarScanner/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/ai-car-scanner-icon.png') as im:
        assert im.mode == 'RGB' and im.size == (1024, 1024)
    print('Native logo transparency and platform formats: PASS')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--check', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not args.check:
        regenerate()
    check()

"""Run the complete Desktop regression matrix in isolated pytest processes.

Usage (from finalbuild/):
    python scripts/run_desktop_tests.py
    python scripts/run_desktop_tests.py --group negative
    python scripts/run_desktop_tests.py --min-coverage 90

A process per group isolates Qt lifecycle issues between UI/widget tests.
The diagnostic-e2e group exercises actual FastAPI routes with an in-process
Desktop transport adapter, without a running network backend.
No physical OBD device, remote API, cloud AI provider or PostgreSQL needed.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from xml.etree import ElementTree

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
# Product runtime modules. Debug probes and PyInstaller-only hooks are still
# included in the full-inventory number, but not the production-core subtotal.
PRODUCTION_MODULES = frozenset({
    "api_client.py", "models.py", "storage.py", "main.py", "product_app.py", "business_workspace.py",
    "backend_worker.py", "ui.py", "prepare_windows_icon.py",
    "stage_windows_icons.py", "verify_icons.py",
    "vehicle_artwork.py", "backend_recovery.py",
})
GROUPS = {
    "logic": (
        "apps/desktop/test_smoke.py",
        "apps/desktop/tests",
        "tests/desktop",
        "--ignore=apps/desktop/tests/test_ui_pom.py",
        "--ignore=apps/desktop/tests/test_ui_widgets.py",
        "--ignore=apps/desktop/tests/test_negative_api_contract.py",
        "--ignore=apps/desktop/tests/test_negative_storage.py",
        "--ignore=apps/desktop/tests/test_verify_icons_negative.py",
        "--ignore=apps/desktop/tests/test_real_backend_diagnostic_e2e.py",
    ),
    "diagnostic-e2e": (
        "apps/desktop/tests/test_real_backend_diagnostic_e2e.py",
    ),
    "negative": (
        "apps/desktop/tests/test_negative_api_contract.py",
        "apps/desktop/tests/test_negative_storage.py",
        "apps/desktop/tests/test_verify_icons_negative.py",
    ),
    "ui-pom": ("apps/desktop/tests/test_ui_pom.py",),
    "ui-widgets": ("apps/desktop/tests/test_ui_widgets.py",),
}


def run_group(name: str, arguments: tuple[str, ...], reports: Path, env: dict[str, str]) -> dict:
    junit = reports / f"{name}-junit.xml"
    log = reports / f"{name}.log"
    cmd = [
        sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q",
        "-p", "no:benchmark", "--durations=10",
        f"--junitxml={junit}",
        "--cov=apps.desktop", "--cov-append", "--cov-report=",
        *arguments,
    ]
    print(f"[DESKTOP] Running {name}: {len(arguments)} selection arguments", flush=True)
    # Phase 3 exercises the real API in offline/in-memory mode. Prevent a
    # shell DATABASE_URL from triggering SQLAlchemy create_all() on a remote
    # Postgres instance even if pytest plugins import api.main during collect.
    if name == "diagnostic-e2e":
        env = env.copy()
        env.pop("DATABASE_URL", None)
        print("[DESKTOP] diagnostic-e2e: external database disabled", flush=True)
    start = time.perf_counter()
    try:
        with log.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as output:
            completed = subprocess.run(
                cmd, cwd=ROOT, env=env, stdout=output,
                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=600, check=False,
            )
        code, state = completed.returncode, "PASS" if completed.returncode == 0 else "FAIL"
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        code, state = 124, "TIMEOUT"
        with log.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as output:
            output.write("\nDESKTOP GROUP TIMED OUT AFTER 600 SECONDS\n")
    duration = round(time.perf_counter() - start, 2)
    print(f"[DESKTOP] {name}: {state} (exit={code}, {duration}s)", flush=True)
    if state != "PASS":
        tail = log.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines()[-45:]
        print("\n".join(tail), flush=True)
    cases = {}
    if junit.is_file():
        try:
            xml_root = ElementTree.parse(junit).getroot()
            suite = xml_root.find("testsuite") if xml_root.tag == "testsuites" else xml_root
            if suite is not None:
                cases = {
                    label: int(suite.attrib.get(attribute, "0"))
                    for label, attribute in (
                        ("total", "tests"), ("failed", "failures"),
                        ("errors", "errors"), ("skipped", "skipped"),
                    )
                }
                cases["passed"] = max(
                    0, cases["total"] - cases["failed"] - cases["errors"] - cases["skipped"]
                )
        except (OSError, ValueError, ElementTree.ParseError) as exc:
            print(f"[DESKTOP] {name}: could not parse JUnit summary: {exc}", flush=True)
    if cases:
        print(f"[DESKTOP] {name} cases: {cases}", flush=True)
    return {
        "name": name, "status": state, "returncode": code,
        "duration_seconds": duration, "cases": cases,
        "log": str(log.resolve()),
        "junit_xml": str(junit.resolve()),
    }


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--group", choices=("all", *GROUPS), default="all",
        help="Run a single independent test group or all five",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--min-coverage", type=float, default=0.0,
        help="Optional combined Desktop coverage gate (0 disables, 90 is the target)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--min-core-coverage", type=float, default=0.0,
        help="Optional coverage gate for production runtime modules (separate from all-source coverage)",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--reports-dir", default="desktop-test-reports")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not 0 <= args.min_coverage <= 100:
        parser.error("--min-coverage must be between 0 and 100")
    if not 0 <= args.min_core_coverage <= 100:
        parser.error("--min-core-coverage must be between 0 and 100")

    reports = (ROOT / args.reports_dir).resolve()
    reports.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    coverage_file = reports / ".coverage"
    if coverage_file.exists():
        coverage_file.unlink()
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env["PYTHONUTF8"] = "1"
    env["PYTHONIOENCODING"] = "utf-8"
    env["QT_QPA_PLATFORM"] = "offscreen"
    env["QT_STYLE_OVERRIDE"] = "Fusion"
    env["AI_CAR_DISABLE_LLM_AUTOSTART"] = "1"
    env["COVERAGE_FILE"] = str(coverage_file)
    # No accidental live HTTP requests in tests; all API operations use mocks.
    env.pop("AI_CAR_SHUTDOWN_TRACE_PATH", None)
    env.pop("AI_CAR_TEST_AUTOCLOSE_MS", None)
    env.pop("AI_CAR_QT_EXPLICIT_CLEANUP", None)
    selection = GROUPS if args.group == "all" else {args.group: GROUPS[args.group]}
    results = [run_group(name, items, reports, env) for name, items in selection.items()]

    percent = None
    core_percent = None
    if coverage_file.exists():
        for fmt, flag, filename in (
            ("XML", "xml", "coverage.xml"),
            ("HTML", "html", "htmlcov"),
            ("JSON", "json", "coverage.json"),
        ):
            cmd = [sys.executable, "-m", "coverage", flag,
                   "-d" if flag == "html" else "-o", str(reports / filename)]
            completed = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=ROOT, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
            if completed.returncode != 0:
                print(f"[DESKTOP] Coverage {fmt}: FAIL: {completed.stderr.strip()}")
        summary_file = reports / "coverage.json"
        if summary_file.exists():
            percent = round(
                json.loads(summary_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["totals"]["percent_covered"], 2
            )
            print(f"[DESKTOP] Combined source coverage: {percent}% (target >=90%)")
            # Preserve the complete inventory: low-coverage production code
            # stays in the denominator instead of silently excluding files.
            data = json.loads(summary_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            per_file = []
            for filename, record in data.get("files", {}).items():
                counts = record.get("summary", {})
                missed = counts.get("missing_lines", 0)
                statements = counts.get("num_statements", 0)
                if not statements:
                    continue
                per_file.append({
                    "file": filename,
                    "statements": statements,
                    "missing": missed,
                    "coverage": round(counts.get("percent_covered", 0), 2),
                    "missing_lines": record.get("missing_lines", []),
                })
            per_file.sort(key=lambda row: (-row["missing"], row["file"]))
            core = [
                row for row in per_file
                if row["file"].replace("\\", "/").startswith("apps/desktop/")
                and row["file"].replace("\\", "/").rsplit("/", 1)[-1] in PRODUCTION_MODULES
            ]
            if core:
                total = sum(row["statements"] for row in core)
                missing = sum(row["missing"] for row in core)
                core_percent = round((total - missing) * 100 / total, 2) if total else None
                print(
                    f"[DESKTOP] Production core source coverage: {core_percent}% "
                    f"({len(core)}/{len(PRODUCTION_MODULES)} modules, target >=90%)"
                )
            # Never pass a production-core gate with missing modules.
            if len(core) != len(PRODUCTION_MODULES):
                core_percent = None
                print("[DESKTOP] Production core coverage incomplete: expected "
                      f"{len(PRODUCTION_MODULES)} module reports; found {len(core)}")
            coverage_gaps = reports / "coverage-gaps.json"
            coverage_gaps.write_text(
                json.dumps(per_file, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
            )
            print("[DESKTOP] Largest uncovered source modules:")
            for item in per_file[:15]:
                line_preview = item["missing_lines"][:18]
                print(f"  {item['file']}: {item['coverage']}%, "
                      f"missing={item['missing']}/{item['statements']}, "
                      f"lines={line_preview}", flush=True)
            print(f"[DESKTOP] Full file-by-file gaps: {coverage_gaps}")
    if percent is None:
        print("[DESKTOP] No coverage result available.")

    if args.min_coverage and (percent is None or percent < args.min_coverage):
        print(f"[DESKTOP] Coverage gate FAIL: {percent} < {args.min_coverage}")
        results.append({"name": "coverage-gate", "status": "FAIL", "threshold": args.min_coverage})
    if args.min_core_coverage and (core_percent is None or core_percent < args.min_core_coverage):
        print(f"[DESKTOP] Production core coverage gate FAIL: {core_percent} < {args.min_core_coverage}")
        results.append({"name": "core-coverage-gate", "status": "FAIL",
                        "threshold": args.min_core_coverage})
    passed = sum(entry["status"] == "PASS" for entry in results)
    failures = sum(entry["status"] != "PASS" for entry in results)
    data = {
        "status": "PASS" if failures == 0 else "FAIL",
        "group_results": results,
        "passed_groups": passed,
        "failed_groups": failures,
        "combined_coverage_percent": percent,
        "production_core_coverage_percent": core_percent,
        "production_module_names": sorted(PRODUCTION_MODULES),
        "coverage_target_percent": 90,
        "coverage_gate_applied_percent": args.min_coverage,
        "core_coverage_gate_applied_percent": args.min_core_coverage,
        "report_dir": str(reports),
    }
    summary = reports / "summary.json"
    summary.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"[DESKTOP] OVERALL: {data['status']} / report: {summary}", flush=True)
    return 1 if failures else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
from uuid import NAMESPACE_URL, uuid5

from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
CATALOG_FILE = ROOT / "data" / "vehicle_catalog.json"
FITMENTS_FILE = ROOT / "data" / "vehicle_fitments.json"
DATABASE_URL = os.getenv(
    "DATABASE_URL",
    "postgresql+psycopg://diagnostic:diagnostic@localhost:5432/diagnostic",
)


def stable_id(*parts: object):
    return uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, "ai-car-scaner:vehicle-catalog:" + "|".join(str(x) for x in parts))


def expand_catalog(data: dict) -> list[dict]:
    rows: list[dict] = []
    source_name = str((data.get("source") or {}).get("name") or "canonical-json")
    for make in data.get("makes", []):
        make_name = str(make.get("make", "")).strip()
        for model in make.get("models", []):
            model_name = str(model.get("model", "")).strip()
            year_ranges = model.get("year_ranges", [])
            engines = [str(x).strip() for x in model.get("engine_families", []) if str(x).strip()]
            scope = str(model.get("engine_data_scope") or "family-level")
            for year_range in year_ranges:
                if not isinstance(year_range, list) or len(year_range) != 2:
                    continue
                start, end = int(year_range[0]), int(year_range[1])
                for year in range(min(start, end), max(start, end) + 1):
                    for engine in engines or ["unknown"]:
                        key = (make_name, model_name, None, year, engine, None)
                        rows.append(
                            {
                                "id": stable_id(*key),
                                "make": make_name,
                                "model": model_name,
                                "chassis": None,
                                "year": year,
                                "engine": engine,
                                "ecu": None,
                                "fuel": json.dumps(model.get("common_fuels") or []),
                                "source": source_name,
                                "scope": scope,
                                "metadata": json.dumps(
                                    {
                                        "vehicle_type": model.get("vehicle_type"),
                                        "notes": model.get("notes"),
                                        "engine_market_note": model.get("engine_market_note"),
                                    }
                                ),
                            }
                        )
    return rows


def expand_fitments(data: dict) -> list[dict]:
    rows: list[dict] = []
    for entry in data.get("entries", []):
        make = str(entry.get("make", "")).strip()
        model = str(entry.get("model", "")).strip()
        chassis = str(entry.get("chassis", "")).strip() or None
        for year in entry.get("years", []):
            for engine_data in entry.get("engines", []):
                engine = str(engine_data.get("name", "")).strip()
                for ecu in engine_data.get("ecus", []) or [None]:
                    ecu_value = str(ecu).strip() if ecu is not None else None
                    key = (make, model, chassis, int(year), engine, ecu_value)
                    rows.append(
                        {
                            "id": stable_id(*key),
                            "make": make,
                            "model": model,
                            "chassis": chassis,
                            "year": int(year),
                            "engine": engine,
                            "ecu": ecu_value,
                            "fuel": json.dumps([]),
                            "source": "vehicle_fitments.json",
                            "scope": "curated-fitment",
                            "metadata": json.dumps(
                                {
                                    "fitment_note": "Curated selector hint; exact vehicle fitment still requires VIN/ECU identification.",
                                }
                            ),
                        }
                    )
    return rows


def seed() -> None:
    catalog = json.loads(CATALOG_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    fitments = json.loads(FITMENTS_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    rows = expand_catalog(catalog) + expand_fitments(fitments)

    engine = create_engine(DATABASE_URL, future=True)
    with engine.begin() as conn:
        conn.execute(
            text(
                """
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vehicle_catalog_entries (
                    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
                    make TEXT NOT NULL,
                    model TEXT NOT NULL,
                    chassis TEXT,
                    year INT NOT NULL,
                    engine TEXT NOT NULL,
                    ecu TEXT,
                    fuel JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
                    source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',
                    scope TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'family-level',
                    metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
                    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
                    UNIQUE (make, model, chassis, year, engine, ecu)
                )
                """
            )
        )
        conn.execute(text("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_vehicle_catalog_make ON vehicle_catalog_entries(make)"))
        conn.execute(text("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_vehicle_catalog_make_model ON vehicle_catalog_entries(make, model)"))
        conn.execute(text("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_vehicle_catalog_model_chassis ON vehicle_catalog_entries(make, model, chassis)"))
        conn.execute(text("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_vehicle_catalog_year ON vehicle_catalog_entries(make, model, chassis, year)"))
        conn.execute(text("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_vehicle_catalog_engine ON vehicle_catalog_entries(make, model, chassis, year, engine)"))

        conn.execute(
            text(
                """
                INSERT INTO vehicle_catalog_entries
                    (id, make, model, chassis, year, engine, ecu, fuel, source, scope, metadata)
                VALUES
                    (:id, :make, :model, :chassis, :year, :engine, :ecu,
                     CAST(:fuel AS jsonb), :source, :scope, CAST(:metadata AS jsonb))
                ON CONFLICT (make, model, chassis, year, engine, ecu)
                DO UPDATE SET
                    fuel = EXCLUDED.fuel,
                    source = EXCLUDED.source,
                    scope = EXCLUDED.scope,
                    metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata
                """
            ),
            rows,
        )

    exact_count = sum(1 for row in rows if row["scope"] == "curated-fitment")
    print(f"Seeded/updated {len(rows)} catalog rows ({exact_count} curated fitment rows).")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    seed()

"""Smoke-test the actual frozen Windows Desktop EXE, including clean shutdown.

No real backend, LLM, OBD adapter, or internet required. The local mock HTTP
server handles health and device discovery while a test-only Qt timer closes
the frozen app. The release EXE must exit 0 and emit all lifecycle markers.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from collections import Counter
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--exe",
        default="dist-release/icon-preview/AICarScanner.exe",
        help="Path to a Windows frozen Desktop executable, relative to finalbuild",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=60)
    parser.add_argument("--auto-close-ms", type=int, default=2500)
    parser.add_argument("--fusion", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--explicit-cleanup", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--reports-dir", default="desktop-test-reports")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    exe = (ROOT / args.exe).resolve()
    if sys.platform != "win32":
        parser.error("Packaged Desktop smoke test requires Windows")
    if not exe.is_file():
        parser.error(f"Frozen executable not found: {exe}")
    if args.timeout < 5 or args.auto_close_ms < 200 or args.auto_close_ms > 30000:
        parser.error("timeout >=5 and auto-close-ms within 200..30000 required")

    report_dir = (ROOT / args.reports_dir).resolve()
    report_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    tag = "fusion-cleanup" if args.fusion and args.explicit_cleanup else (
        "fusion" if args.fusion else "explicit-cleanup" if args.explicit_cleanup else "baseline"
    )
    trace_path = report_dir / f"packaged-{tag}-shutdown.log"
    console_path = report_dir / f"packaged-{tag}-console.log"
    result_path = report_dir / f"packaged-{tag}-result.json"
    trace_path.write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
    hits: Counter[str] = Counter()
    guard = threading.Lock()

    class MockDesktopApi(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        def do_GET(self):
            path = self.path.split("?", 1)[0]
            with guard:
                hits[path] += 1
            if path == "/health":
                body = {"status": "ok"}
            elif path == "/api/v1/devices":
                body = {"devices": []}
            elif path == "/api/v1/vehicle-catalog/entries":
                body = []
            else:
                self.send_error(404, "unknown mock endpoint")
                return
            data = json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8")
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(data)

        def log_message(self, *_args):
            return

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="ai-car-desktop-smoke-") as temp:
        server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), MockDesktopApi)
        server.daemon_threads = True
        thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        thread.start()
        env = os.environ.copy()
        env["APPDATA"] = temp
        env["AI_CAR_BACKEND_URL"] = f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}"
        # Force all backend requests to stay on the in-process mock server.
        env["NO_PROXY"] = "127.0.0.1,localhost"
        env["no_proxy"] = "127.0.0.1,localhost"
        env["AI_CAR_DISABLE_LLM_AUTOSTART"] = "1"
        env["AI_CAR_TEST_AUTOCLOSE_MS"] = str(args.auto_close_ms)
        env["AI_CAR_SHUTDOWN_TRACE_PATH"] = str(trace_path)
        env["AI_CAR_DISABLE_NATIVE_TASKBAR_ICON"] = "1"
        env["QT_QPA_PLATFORM"] = "offscreen"
        env["QT_DEBUG_PLUGINS"] = "0"
        if args.fusion:
            env["QT_STYLE_OVERRIDE"] = "Fusion"
        else:
            env.pop("QT_STYLE_OVERRIDE", None)
        env["AI_CAR_QT_EXPLICIT_CLEANUP"] = "1" if args.explicit_cleanup else "0"
        env.pop("PYTHONHOME", None)
        env.pop("PYTHONPATH", None)
        start = time.monotonic()
        returncode = None
        timeout_happened = False
        try:
            with console_path.open("wb") as output:
                process = subprocess.Popen(
                    [str(exe)], cwd=exe.parent, env=env,
                    stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                )
                try:
                    returncode = process.wait(timeout=args.timeout)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    timeout_happened = True
                    # PyInstaller onefile may spawn a child process. On timeout
                    # terminate the entire Windows process tree, not just the
                    # bootloader parent; never leave a hung UI on the runner.
                    subprocess.run(
                        ["taskkill", "/PID", str(process.pid), "/T", "/F"],
                        capture_output=True, timeout=20, check=False,
                    )
                    try:
                        process.wait(timeout=5)
                    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                        process.kill()
                        process.wait(timeout=5)
        finally:
            server.shutdown()
            server.server_close()
            thread.join(timeout=5)
        elapsed = round(time.monotonic() - start, 2)

    trace = trace_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    with guard:
        hit_counts = dict(hits)
    required_markers = (
        "smoke: main_window_shown",
        "ui: QApplication.exec returned rc=0",
        "ui: returning to main.run",
        "main: backend/LLM cleanup complete",
    )
    missing = [marker for marker in required_markers if marker not in trace]
    missing_http = [path for path in ("/health", "/api/v1/devices") if not hit_counts.get(path)]
    success = returncode == 0 and not timeout_happened and not missing and not missing_http
    summary = {
        "status": "PASS" if success else "FAIL",
        "executable": str(exe),
        "variant": tag,
        "returncode": returncode,
        "timeout": timeout_happened,
        "elapsed_seconds": elapsed,
        "mock_backend_requests": hit_counts,
        "missing_lifecycle_markers": missing,
        "missing_mock_requests": missing_http,
        "trace_file": str(trace_path),
        "console_file": str(console_path),
    }
    result_path.write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"[DESKTOP-EXE] {tag}: {summary['status']} exit={returncode}, elapsed={elapsed}s")
    print(f"[DESKTOP-EXE] Mock API: {hit_counts}")
    print(f"[DESKTOP-EXE] Trace: {trace_path}")
    if not success:
        print(f"[DESKTOP-EXE] Missing lifecycle markers: {missing}")
        print(f"[DESKTOP-EXE] Missing API requests: {missing_http}")
        print("\n".join(console_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines()[-30:]))
    return 0 if success else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Refresh the native offline selection snapshot from backend generation references."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import json
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "backend"))
from obd.catalog import selector_entries


def build_snapshot(payload):
    result = dict(payload)
    rows = [r for r in payload["vehicles"] if r.get("scope") != "generation-reference-not-vin-fitment"]
    def key(row):
        return tuple(str(row.get(k, "")).casefold() for k in ("make", "model", "chassis", "year", "engine"))
    keys = {key(row) for row in rows}
    for row in selector_entries():
        if key(row) not in keys:
            rows.append({k: row.get(k) for k in ("make", "model", "chassis", "year", "engine", "ecu", "source", "scope")} | {"fuel": row["fuel"][0].title()})
            keys.add(key(row))
    result["vehicles"] = rows
    result["description"] = "Backend-generated selection snapshot shared by native clients. Online backend entries take precedence. Generation/engine ranges are guidance, not verified VIN fitment."
    return result


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    path = ROOT / "shared/vehicle_catalog.json"
    current = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    expected = json.dumps(build_snapshot(json.loads(current)), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n"

        return 0 if all(p.is_file() and p.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == expected for p in paths) else 1
    for target in paths:

        target.write_text(expected, encoding="utf-8")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Real local FastAPI crash -> bounded auto-restart integration test.

This starts ONLY disposable child processes and a temporary SQLite database.
Does not touch the user's running API, permanent database, or OBD devices.
Run from finalbuild: python scripts/test_fastapi_recovery_integration.py
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import traceback

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
OUT = ROOT / "desktop-test-reports" / "fastapi-recovery"

probe_path = Path(__file__).with_name("test_fastapi_startup.py")
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("aicar_fastapi_probe_helpers", probe_path)
assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
helper = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(helper)


def wait_until(predicate, timeout_seconds: float, interval: float = 0.5) -> bool:
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout_seconds
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        if predicate():
            return True
        time.sleep(interval)
    return bool(predicate())


def execute() -> int:
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    report_file = OUT / "source-integration.json"
    log_file = OUT / "source-backend.log"
    sandbox = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="aicar-recovery-"))
    port = helper.ephemeral_port()
    tracked = (
        "APPDATA", "DATABASE_URL", "AI_CAR_USE_LOCAL_DATABASE",
        "AI_CAR_BACKEND_HOST", "AI_CAR_BACKEND_PORT", "AI_CAR_BACKEND_URL",
        "AI_CAR_DISABLE_LLM_AUTOSTART", "AI_CAR_BACKEND_STARTUP_TIMEOUT",
        "NO_PROXY", "no_proxy",
    )
    original_env = {key: os.environ.get(key) for key in tracked}
    started = time.monotonic()
    report = {
        "status": "FAIL",
        "scenario": "real FastAPI child termination -> recovery supervisor restart",
        "mode": "source",
        "port": port,
        "health_before_crash": False,
        "original_pid": None,
        "replacement_pid": None,
        "health_after_recovery": False,
        "supervisor_exhausted": None,
        "cleanup": "PENDING",
        "errors": [],
        "log": str(log_file.relative_to(ROOT)),
    }
    desktop_main = None
    supervisor = None

    try:
        os.environ.update({
            "APPDATA": str(sandbox),
            "DATABASE_URL": "sqlite:///" + (sandbox / "diagnostic.sqlite").as_posix(),
            "AI_CAR_USE_LOCAL_DATABASE": "1",
            "AI_CAR_BACKEND_HOST": "127.0.0.1",
            "AI_CAR_BACKEND_PORT": str(port),
            "AI_CAR_BACKEND_URL": f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}",
            "AI_CAR_DISABLE_LLM_AUTOSTART": "1",
            "AI_CAR_BACKEND_STARTUP_TIMEOUT": "90",
            "NO_PROXY": "127.0.0.1,localhost",
            "no_proxy": "127.0.0.1,localhost",
        })

        from apps.desktop import main as desktop_main
        from apps.desktop.backend_recovery import BackendRecoverySupervisor

        if not desktop_main.LOCAL_BACKEND or desktop_main.PORT != port:
            raise AssertionError("Launcher is not configured for the isolated test port")

        original = desktop_main.start_backend()
        if original is None or original.poll() is not None:
            raise AssertionError("Desktop did not start and own its FastAPI child")
        report["original_pid"] = original.pid

        report["health_before_crash"] = helper.is_healthy(port)
        if not report["health_before_crash"]:
            raise AssertionError("Real /health never became healthy before crash")

        supervisor = BackendRecoverySupervisor(
            process=lambda: desktop_main._backend_process,
            restart=desktop_main.start_backend,
            healthy=desktop_main._backend_healthy,
            poll_seconds=1.0,
            max_restarts=3,
            window_seconds=120,
        )
        if not supervisor.start():
            raise AssertionError("Recovery supervisor did not start")

        # Kill only the Popen PID we created; do not shut down any other API.
        helper.stop_child(original, frozen=False)
        if original.poll() is None:
            raise AssertionError("Original FastAPI child did not stop")

        def recovered() -> bool:
            current = desktop_main._backend_process
            if current is None or current is original or current.poll() is not None:
                return False
            if current.pid == original.pid:
                return False
            if not helper.is_healthy(port):
                return False
            report["replacement_pid"] = current.pid
            return True

        report["health_after_recovery"] = wait_until(recovered, 100)
        report["supervisor_exhausted"] = supervisor.exhausted
        if not report["health_after_recovery"]:
            raise AssertionError("FastAPI did not auto-restart and restore /health")
        if supervisor.exhausted:
            raise AssertionError("Recovery exhausted its attempt budget")

        report["status"] = "PASS"
    except Exception as exc:
        report["errors"].append(f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
        report["traceback"] = traceback.format_exc(limit=12)
    finally:
        if supervisor is not None:
            supervisor.stop(join_timeout=100)
            if supervisor._thread is not None and supervisor._thread.is_alive():
                report["status"] = "FAIL"
                report["errors"].append("Recovery thread did not stop before cleanup")
        if desktop_main is not None:
            try:
                desktop_main.stop_backend()
            except Exception as exc:
                report["status"] = "FAIL"
                report["errors"].append(f"Local backend shutdown failed: {exc}")

        source_log = sandbox / "AI-Car-Scanner" / "backend.log"
        if source_log.exists():
            try:
                shutil.copyfile(source_log, log_file)
            except OSError as exc:
                report["errors"].append(f"Could not copy backend log: {exc}")
        for key, old_value in original_env.items():
            if old_value is None:
                os.environ.pop(key, None)
            else:
                os.environ[key] = old_value

        try:
            helper.cleanup_temporary_database(sandbox, attempts=15)
            report["cleanup"] = "PASS"
        except OSError as exc:
            report["cleanup"] = "FAIL"
            report["status"] = "FAIL"
            report["errors"].append(
                f"Temporary SQLite cleanup blocked: {exc}. Sandbox: {sandbox}"
            )

        report["elapsed_seconds"] = round(time.monotonic() - started, 2)
        report_file.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        print(
            f"[FASTAPI-RECOVERY] {report['status']} | "
            f"crashed_pid={report['original_pid']} "
            f"restarted_pid={report['replacement_pid']} "
            f"health={report['health_after_recovery']} "
            f"cleanup={report['cleanup']}",
            flush=True,
        )
        print(f"[FASTAPI-RECOVERY] Evidence: {report_file}", flush=True)
        if report["status"] != "PASS":
            for error in report["errors"]:
                print(f"[FASTAPI-RECOVERY] FAIL: {error}", flush=True)

    return 0 if report["status"] == "PASS" and report["cleanup"] == "PASS" else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(execute())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Launch actual source/frozen FastAPI locally, verify /health and record evidence.

This is NOT the mock backend used by visible UI smoke tests.
No CI/CD, remote database, network calls or physical vehicle are required.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from urllib.request import urlopen

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = ROOT / "desktop-test-reports" / "fastapi-startup"


def ephemeral_port() -> int:
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as sock:
        sock.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        return int(sock.getsockname()[1])


def is_healthy(port: int) -> bool:
    try:
        with urlopen(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/health", timeout=1.0) as response:
            data = json.load(response)
            return (
                response.status == 200 and isinstance(data, dict)
                and data.get("status") == "ok"
                and data.get("service") == "diagnostic-api"
            )
    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError):
        return False


def stop_child(process: subprocess.Popen, frozen: bool) -> None:
    """Stop only the child started by this probe, including Windows descendants.

    On Windows, backend_worker may have child processes holding SQLite open;
    terminating only the parent leaves diagnostic.sqlite locked.
    """
    if process.poll() is not None:
        return
    if sys.platform == "win32":
        # /PID is the exact Popen PID; /T only targets descendants of this PID.
        command = ["taskkill", "/PID", str(process.pid), "/T", "/F"]
        result = subprocess.run(
            command, capture_output=True, check=False, timeout=20,
            creationflags=getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0),
        )
        try:
            process.wait(timeout=12)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            process.kill()
            process.wait(timeout=8)
        if result.returncode != 0 and process.poll() is None:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Could not stop probe process tree PID={process.pid}: "
                + result.stderr.decode(errors="replace")[-400:]
            )
        return
    process.terminate()
    try:
        process.wait(timeout=10)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        process.kill()
        process.wait(timeout=10)


def cleanup_temporary_database(folder: Path, *, attempts: int = 10) -> None:
    """Bounded Windows cleanup retry for delayed SQLite/AV handle release.

    Raises if deletion truly remains blocked. Caller writes a FAIL report with
    the preserved temporary folder path rather than losing startup evidence.
    """
    for attempt in range(attempts):
        try:
            shutil.rmtree(folder)
            return
        except FileNotFoundError:
            return
        except (PermissionError, OSError):
            if attempt == attempts - 1:
                raise
            time.sleep(min(0.3 + 0.2 * attempt, 1.0))



def run_probe(mode: str, exe: Path | None, timeout: float) -> dict:
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    log_path = OUT / f"{mode}.log"
    json_path = OUT / f"{mode}.json"
    port = ephemeral_port()
    started = time.monotonic()
    status = "FAIL"
    health_reached = False
    exit_code = None
    error = None

    temp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="aicar-fastapi-"))
    cleanup_error = None
    try:
        env = os.environ.copy()
        env["APPDATA"] = str(temp)
        env["DATABASE_URL"] = "sqlite:///" + (Path(temp) / "diagnostic.sqlite").as_posix()
        env["AI_CAR_DESKTOP_LOCAL_DB"] = "1"
        env["AI_CAR_BACKEND_HOST"] = "127.0.0.1"
        env["AI_CAR_BACKEND_PORT"] = str(port)
        env["AI_CAR_DISABLE_LLM_AUTOSTART"] = "1"
        env["NO_PROXY"] = "127.0.0.1,localhost"
        env["no_proxy"] = env["NO_PROXY"]
        env.pop("AI_CAR_BACKEND_URL", None)
        if mode == "source":
            env["PYTHONPATH"] = (
                str(ROOT) + os.pathsep + str(ROOT / "backend")
                + (os.pathsep + env["PYTHONPATH"] if env.get("PYTHONPATH") else "")
            )
            command = [sys.executable, "-m", "apps.desktop.backend_worker"]
        else:
            if exe is None or not exe.is_file():
                error = f"Frozen backend EXE missing: {exe}"
                command = None
            else:
                env.pop("PYTHONPATH", None)
                command = [str(exe)]

        if command is not None:
            with log_path.open("wb") as logfile:
                proc = subprocess.Popen(
                    command, cwd=str(ROOT), env=env,
                    stdout=logfile, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                    creationflags=getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0)
                    if sys.platform == "win32" else 0,
                )
                try:
                    while time.monotonic() - started < timeout:
                        exit_code = proc.poll()
                        if exit_code is not None:
                            break
                        if is_healthy(port):
                            health_reached = True
                            status = "PASS"
                            break
                        time.sleep(0.4)
                except Exception as exc:
                    error = str(exc)
                finally:
                    try:
                        stop_child(proc, frozen=(mode == "frozen"))
                    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError, RuntimeError) as exc:
                        error = f"Cannot stop owned FastAPI process: {exc}"
                        status = "FAIL"
        else:
            log_path.write_text(str(error), encoding="utf-8")
    finally:
        try:
            cleanup_temporary_database(temp)
        except OSError as exc:
            cleanup_error = (
                f"Temporary SQLite cleanup blocked after retries: {exc}. "
                f"Inspect only this probe's folder: {temp}"
            )
            status = "FAIL"
            error = f"{error}; {cleanup_error}" if error else cleanup_error

    result = {
        "status": status, "mode": mode, "health": health_reached,
        "port": port, "elapsed_seconds": round(time.monotonic() - started, 2),
        "exit_code_before_cleanup": exit_code,
        "error": error, "log": str(log_path.relative_to(ROOT)),
        "cleanup": "PASS" if cleanup_error is None else "FAIL",
        "temporary_directory_if_locked": str(temp) if cleanup_error else None,
    }
    json_path.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"[FASTAPI] {mode}: {status} | {json_path}", flush=True)
    if status != "PASS":
        print("\n".join(log_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines()[-65:]))
    return result


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--mode", choices=("source", "frozen", "both"), default="source")
    parser.add_argument("--exe", default="dist-release/icon-preview/backend_service.exe")
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=float, default=90)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not 5 <= args.timeout <= 300:
        parser.error("--timeout must be 5..300 seconds")
    if args.mode in {"frozen", "both"} and sys.platform != "win32":
        parser.error("Frozen startup probe requires Windows")
    exe = (ROOT / args.exe).resolve()
    modes = ["source", "frozen"] if args.mode == "both" else [args.mode]
    results = [run_probe(mode, exe, args.timeout) for mode in modes]
    return 0 if all(result["status"] == "PASS" for result in results) else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

import json

import pytest

from ai.ingestion.chunker import ChunkingConfig, SemanticChunker
from ai.ingestion.models import DocumentMetadata
from ai.ingestion.pipeline import IngestionConfig, KnowledgeIngestionPipeline


def test_ingest_file_normalizes_metadata_and_builds_chunks(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "w211.txt"
    path.write_text(
        "P0302 misfire is reported under LPG load.\n\n"
        "Compare petrol and LPG behavior, then measure trims and gas pressure.",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    pipeline = KnowledgeIngestionPipeline(
        IngestionConfig(source="local-test", default_language="hy"),
        chunker=SemanticChunker(ChunkingConfig(target_chars=45, overlap_chars=0, min_chars=1)),
    )

    result = pipeline.ingest_file(path, DocumentMetadata(source="unknown", tags=("misfire",)))

    assert result.skipped is False
    assert result.document.title == "w211"
    assert result.document.metadata.source == "local-test"
    assert result.document.metadata.language == "en"  # explicit metadata stays authoritative
    assert result.document.content_hash
    assert result.document.char_count == len(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert result.chunks
    assert all(chunk.document_id == result.document.document_id for chunk in result.chunks)
    assert result.chunks[0].metadata["content_type"] == "text/plain"
    assert result.chunks[0].metadata["source_path"] == str(path)


def test_ingest_file_preserves_explicit_source_and_title(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "guide.md"
    path.write_text("Useful diagnostic information with enough content to index.", encoding="utf-8")
    pipeline = KnowledgeIngestionPipeline()

    result = pipeline.ingest_file(path, DocumentMetadata(source="oem-manual", language="hy"), title="Workshop guide")

    assert result.document.title == "Workshop guide"
    assert result.document.metadata.source == "oem-manual"
    assert result.document.metadata.language == "hy"


def test_empty_document_can_fail_or_return_warning(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "empty.txt"
    path.write_text(" \n\t ", encoding="utf-8")

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="no extractable text"):
        KnowledgeIngestionPipeline(IngestionConfig(fail_on_empty=True)).ingest_file(path, DocumentMetadata())

    result = KnowledgeIngestionPipeline(
        IngestionConfig(source="test", fail_on_empty=False)
    ).ingest_file(path, DocumentMetadata())

    assert result.chunks == ()
    assert result.warnings and "no extractable text" in result.warnings[0]


def test_nonempty_document_with_no_chunks_adds_warning(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "content.txt"
    path.write_text("Readable content that a deliberately empty chunker will not emit.", encoding="utf-8")

    class EmptyChunker:
        def chunk(self, document_id, parsed, base_metadata):
            return []

    result = KnowledgeIngestionPipeline(chunker=EmptyChunker()).ingest_file(path, DocumentMetadata())
    assert result.chunks == ()
    assert result.warnings == ("No chunks were generated",)


def test_ingest_directory_filters_extensions_sorts_and_applies_suffix_metadata(tmp_path):
    (tmp_path / "b.md").write_text("Second diagnostic guide with useful text.", encoding="utf-8")
    (tmp_path / "a.txt").write_text("First diagnostic guide with useful text.", encoding="utf-8")
    (tmp_path / "ignore.bin").write_bytes(b"not a parser-supported document")
    pipeline = KnowledgeIngestionPipeline(IngestionConfig(source="directory", default_language="ru"))

    results = pipeline.ingest_directory(
        tmp_path,
        metadata_by_suffix={".md": DocumentMetadata(source="curated", language="hy")},
    )

    assert [result.document.title for result in results] == ["a", "b"]
    assert results[0].document.metadata.source == "directory"
    assert results[0].document.metadata.language == "ru"
    assert results[1].document.metadata.source == "curated"
    assert results[1].document.metadata.language == "hy"


def test_manifest_and_save_manifest_serialize_warnings_and_metadata(tmp_path):
    source = tmp_path / "source.txt"
    source.write_text("A short diagnostic document for manifest generation.", encoding="utf-8")
    pipeline = KnowledgeIngestionPipeline()
    result = pipeline.ingest_file(source, DocumentMetadata(source="test"))
    rows = pipeline.manifest([result])

    assert rows[0]["document_id"] == result.document.document_id
    assert rows[0]["chunk_count"] == len(result.chunks)
    assert rows[0]["metadata"]["source"] == "test"
    assert rows[0]["warnings"] == []
    assert rows[0]["skipped"] is False

    target = tmp_path / "manifest.json"
    pipeline.save_manifest([result], target)
    assert json.loads(target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) == rows

    empty_target = tmp_path / "empty.json"
    pipeline.save_manifest([], empty_target)
    assert json.loads(empty_target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) == []

        stats=[SignalStats(
            session_id=sid, pid="RPM", count=3, start_ms=100, end_ms=300,

            session_id=sid, pid="RPM", event_type=SignalEventType.STEP_CHANGE,
            start_ms=200, end_ms=300, severity="HIGH", message="step",
            evidence_fact="Measured RPM step", metrics={"delta": 800},
        )],
    )


def test_recent_signal_context_sorts_samples_groups_and_caps_history():
    sid = uuid4()
    samples = [
        TelemetrySample(session_id=sid, timestamp_ms=i, pid="RPM", value=i, unit="rpm", sequence=i)
        for i in range(10, 0, -1)
    ]
    samples += [
        TelemetrySample(session_id=sid, timestamp_ms=i, pid="MAP", value=i * 2, unit="kPa")
        for i in (1, 2)
    ]
    context = live_analysis._recent_signal_context(samples, max_per_signal=3)

    assert context[0]["unit"] == "kPa"

    session = DiagnosticSession(vehicle=Vehicle(make="Mercedes-Benz", model="W211"))

class FakeEngine:
    def analyze(self, session):
        session.audit_log.append({"event": "FAKE_ANALYZED"})
        return session


class FakeProvider:
    class Response:
        provider = "fake-provider"
        model = "fake-model"
        text = "Check pressure and compare fuel modes."
    async def generate(self, prompt, context):
        assert "telemetry" in prompt
        assert context["recent_live_signals"]
        return self.Response()


class BrokenProvider:
    config = SimpleNamespace(model="offline-model")
    async def generate(self, prompt, context):
        raise RuntimeError("LLM offline")


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_analyze_live_session_returns_provider_result_and_deterministic_fallback(monkeypatch):
    session = DiagnosticSession()
    summary = _summary(session.session_id)
    sample = TelemetrySample(session_id=session.session_id, timestamp_ms=100, pid="RPM", value=750, unit="rpm")
    monkeypatch.setattr(live_analysis, "DiagnosticIntelligenceEngine", FakeEngine)
    monkeypatch.setattr(live_analysis, "build_llm_provider", lambda: FakeProvider())

    success = await live_analysis.analyze_live_session(session, summary, [sample])
    assert success["evidence_added"] == 2
    assert success["ai"] == {
        "available": True,
        "provider": "fake-provider",
        "model": "fake-model",
        "text": "Check pressure and compare fuel modes.",
    }
    assert success["session"]["audit_log"][-1]["event"] == "FAKE_ANALYZED"

    monkeypatch.setattr(live_analysis, "build_llm_provider", lambda: BrokenProvider())
    failure = await live_analysis.analyze_live_session(session, summary, [sample])
    assert failure["ai"]["available"] is False
    assert failure["ai"]["provider"] == "BrokenProvider"
    assert failure["ai"]["model"] == "offline-model"
    assert failure["ai"]["error"] == "LLM offline"
    assert failure["evidence_added"] == 0

from contextlib import contextmanager

import ai.rag.pgvector_hybrid as pgvector

class FakeResult:
    def __init__(self, rows=()):
        self.rows = rows
    def mappings(self):
        return self
    def all(self):
        return self.rows


class FakeConnection:
    def __init__(self, rows=()):
        self.rows = rows
        self.calls = []
    def execute(self, statement, params=None):
        self.calls.append((str(statement), params))
        return FakeResult(self.rows)


class FakeEngine:
    def __init__(self, connection):
        self.connection = connection
        self.transactions = 0
        self.disposed = False
    @contextmanager
    def begin(self):
        self.transactions += 1
        yield self.connection
    def dispose(self):
        self.disposed = True


def make_row():
    return {
        "chunk_id": str(uuid4()),
        "document_id": str(uuid4()),
        "content": "P0302 misfire under LPG load",
        "metadata": {"make": "Mercedes-Benz"},
        "score": 0.82,
    }


def build_repository(monkeypatch, rows=()):
    connection = FakeConnection(rows)
    engine = FakeEngine(connection)
    monkeypatch.setattr(pgvector, "create_engine", lambda *args, **kwargs: engine)
    repo = pgvector.PgVectorHybridRepository(pgvector.PgVectorConfig("postgresql://unused", dimensions=3))
    return repo, engine, connection

def test_upsert_validates_dimensions_and_executes_parameterized_upsert(monkeypatch):
    repo, engine, connection = build_repository(monkeypatch)
    chunk = SimpleNamespace(
        chunk_id=str(uuid4()),
        document_id=str(uuid4()),
        chunk_index=2,
        content="misfire",
        metadata={"make": "Mercedes-Benz"},
    )
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="embedding dimension 2 != configured 3"):
        repo.upsert_chunks([chunk], [[0.1, 0.2]])
    # The repository enters its transaction before validating individual embedding dimensions.
    # Validation must fail without executing any SQL statements.
    assert engine.transactions == 1
    assert connection.calls == []

    repo.upsert_chunks([chunk], [[0.1, 0.2, 0.3]])
    assert engine.transactions == 2
    sql, params = connection.calls[-1]
    assert "ON CONFLICT (chunk_id) DO UPDATE" in sql
    assert params["chunk_index"] == 2
    assert params["metadata"] == '{"make": "Mercedes-Benz"}'
    assert params["embedding"] == "[0.1,0.2,0.3]"

from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest

from ai.rag.hybrid import RetrievedChunk
from ai.rag.retrieval import DiagnosticRAGRetriever


def make_chunk(chunk_id, content, score, title="Guide"):
    return RetrievedChunk(
        chunk_id=chunk_id,
        document_id="doc-" + chunk_id,
        content=content,
        metadata={"title": title},
        vector_score=score,
        fused_score=score,
    )


class FakeEmbeddingProvider:
    async def embed(self, texts):
        return [[float(len(text))] for text in texts]


class FakeRepository:
    def __init__(self):
        self.calls = []

    def hybrid_search(self, embedding, query, filters=None, top_k=5):
        self.calls.append((embedding, query, filters, top_k))
        if query == "LPG misfire":
            return [make_chunk("a", "LPG injector balance", 0.7), make_chunk("shared", "cylinder misfire", 0.4)], {"source": "first"}
        return [make_chunk("shared", "cylinder misfire", 0.9), make_chunk("b", "fuel pressure under load", 0.6)], {"source": "expanded"}


class MatchingReranker:
    def rerank(self, query, hits, top_k=5):
        assert query == "LPG misfire"
        assert hits
        # Ensure a hit returned by the reranker is mapped back to its source chunk.
        selected = next(hit for hit in hits if hit.text == "cylinder misfire")
        return [SimpleNamespace(hit=SimpleNamespace(text=selected.text, title=selected.title), rerank_score=0.99)]


class IncompatibleReranker:
    def rerank(self, query, hits, top_k=5):
        return [SimpleNamespace(hit=SimpleNamespace(text="not in candidate list", title="unknown"), rerank_score=1.0)]


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_retriever_rewrites_deduplicates_filters_and_maps_reranker_result():
    repository = FakeRepository()
    retriever = DiagnosticRAGRetriever(
        repository,
        FakeEmbeddingProvider(),
        reranker=MatchingReranker(),
        candidate_k_multiplier=2,
    )

    response = await retriever.retrieve("LPG misfire", filters={"make": "Mercedes"}, top_k=1)

    assert response.query == "LPG misfire"
    assert len(response.rewritten_queries) == 2
    assert len(repository.calls) == 2
    assert all(call[2] == {"make": "Mercedes"} for call in repository.calls)
    assert all(call[3] == 2 for call in repository.calls)
    assert response.diagnostics["candidate_count"] == 2
    assert response.diagnostics["result_count"] == 1
    assert response.diagnostics["reranker"] == "MatchingReranker"
    assert response.hits[0].chunk_id == "shared"
    assert response.hits[0].rank == 1
    assert response.hits[0].fused_score == 0.99


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_retriever_uses_best_duplicate_score_before_reranking():
    repository = FakeRepository()
    retriever = DiagnosticRAGRetriever(repository, FakeEmbeddingProvider(), reranker=IncompatibleReranker())
    response = await retriever.retrieve("LPG misfire", top_k=3)

    shared = next(hit for hit in response.hits if hit.chunk_id == "shared")
    assert shared.fused_score == 0.9
    # A custom reranker with incompatible output must not erase usable retrieval results.
    assert [hit.chunk_id for hit in response.hits] == ["shared", "a", "b"]
    assert response.diagnostics["candidate_count"] == 3

def test_lexical_reranker_phrase_match_order_cap_and_top_k():
    phrase = _hit("phrase", "P0302", "misfire on LPG load", 0.3, {"type": "manual"})
    weak = _hit("weak", "brakes", "replace worn pads", 0.8)
    reranker = LexicalReranker()

    results = reranker.rerank("P0302 misfire", [weak, phrase], top_k=1)

    assert len(results) == 1
    assert results[0].hit.document_id == "phrase"
    assert 0 <= results[0].rerank_score <= 1
    assert results[0].hit.metadata == {"type": "manual"}
    assert reranker.rerank("P0302 misfire", [phrase], top_k=0) == []


def test_lexical_reranker_handles_no_query_tokens_and_empty_hits():
    reranker = LexicalReranker()
    assert reranker.rerank("x a _", [], top_k=3) == []
    results = reranker.rerank("x a", [_hit("one", "Generic", "document", 0.0)], top_k=2)
    assert len(results) == 1
    assert results[0].rerank_score >= 0


def test_cross_encoder_is_lazy_predicts_sorts_and_caches_model(monkeypatch):
    # The project intentionally requires an explicit opt-in for native model
    # loading on Windows; this test substitutes a fake model and performs no
    # native load, so authorize the code path explicitly.
    monkeypatch.setenv("RAG_RERANKER_ALLOW_NATIVE", "1")
    model = Mock()
    model.predict.return_value = [0.1, 0.9]
    module = ModuleType("sentence_transformers")
    constructor = Mock(return_value=model)
    module.CrossEncoder = constructor
    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, "sentence_transformers", module)

    reranker = CrossEncoderReranker(model_name="local/test", device="cpu", batch_size=4)
    hits = [_hit("a", "A", "first"), _hit("b", "B", "second")]

def build_case():
    s = DiagnosticSession(vehicle=Vehicle(make="Mercedes-Benz", model="W211", year=2006, engine="M272 3.5", fuel=["petrol", "LPG"]))
    s.evidence.extend([
        Evidence(fact="fuel_mode_lpg", source=EvidenceSource.USER_REPORTED, status=EvidenceStatus.REPORTED),

        Evidence(fact="petrol normal", source=EvidenceSource.USER_REPORTED, status=EvidenceStatus.REPORTED),
        Evidence(fact="acceleration below 2000 RPM", source=EvidenceSource.USER_REPORTED, status=EvidenceStatus.REPORTED),
    ])
    return s


def test_decision_plan_targets_hypotheses_and_scores_candidates():
    engine = DiagnosticIntelligenceEngine()
    session = build_case()
    engine.analyze(session)
    plan = DiagnosticDecisionEngine().build_plan(session)
    assert plan.candidates
    assert plan.selected_test_id == plan.candidates[0].test_id
    assert all(0 <= c.priority_score <= 1 for c in plan.candidates)
    assert any("LPG injection" in " ".join(c.rationale) for c in plan.candidates)


def test_refresh_recommendations_populates_ranked_tests():
    engine = DiagnosticIntelligenceEngine()
    session = build_case()
    engine.analyze(session)
    assert session.recommendations
    assert session.state.value == "TESTING"
    assert session.recommendations[0].priority_score >= session.recommendations[-1].priority_score


def test_test_result_changes_hypothesis_status_without_claiming_component_confirmation():
    engine = DiagnosticIntelligenceEngine()
    session = build_case()
    engine.analyze(session)
    test = session.recommendations[0]
    engine.record_test_result(session, test.id, "LPG pressure drops under load", {"pressure_bar": 0.65})
    assert any(h.status == "supported_by_test" for h in session.hypotheses)
    assert not any("confirmed component" in h.statement.lower() for h in session.hypotheses)
    assert any(x.get("event") == "TEST_RESULT_INTERPRETED" for x in session.audit_log)


def test_pass_and_fail_outcomes_change_target_hypothesis_status():
    engine = DiagnosticIntelligenceEngine()

    passing = build_case()
    engine.analyze(passing)
    passing_test = passing.recommendations[0]
    engine.record_test_result(passing, passing_test.id, "PASS")
    assert any(h.status == "disfavored_by_test" for h in passing.hypotheses)

    failing = build_case()
    engine.analyze(failing)
    failing_test = failing.recommendations[0]
    engine.record_test_result(failing, failing_test.id, "FAIL")
    assert any(h.status == "supported_by_test" for h in failing.hypotheses)


def test_technician_notes_can_drive_test_interpretation():
    engine = DiagnosticIntelligenceEngine()
    session = build_case()
    engine.analyze(session)
    test = session.recommendations[0]
    engine.record_test_result(session, test.id, "INCONCLUSIVE", notes="LPG pressure drops under load")
    assert any(h.status == "supported_by_test" for h in session.hypotheses)

from diagnostic.models import DiagnosticSession, Evidence, EvidenceSource, EvidenceStatus
from ai.reasoning.engine import DiagnosticIntelligenceEngine


def case():
    engine = DiagnosticIntelligenceEngine()
    session = DiagnosticSession(evidence=[
        Evidence(fact="misfire on LPG, petrol normal", source=EvidenceSource.USER_REPORTED,
                 status=EvidenceStatus.REPORTED),
    ])
    engine.analyze(session)
    return engine, session


def scores(session):
    return {h.category: h.confidence_score for h in session.hypotheses}


def test_outcomes_change_scores_and_survive_repeat_analysis_and_persistence():
    for outcome, direction in [("FAIL", 1), ("PASS", -1)]:
        engine, session = case()
        baseline = scores(session)
        test = session.recommendations[0]
        engine.record_test_result(session, test.id, outcome)
        changed = scores(session)
        for target in test.target_hypotheses:
            if target in baseline:
                assert (changed[target] - baseline[target]) * direction > 0
        assert changed != baseline
        restored = DiagnosticSession.model_validate_json(session.model_dump_json())
        engine.analyze(restored)
        assert scores(restored) == changed
        assert list(scores(restored).values()) == sorted(scores(restored).values(), reverse=True)


def test_correcting_same_test_replaces_effect_and_incomplete_withdraws_it():
    engine, session = case()
    baseline = scores(session)
    test = session.recommendations[0]
    engine.record_test_result(session, test.id, "FAIL")
    engine.record_test_result(session, test.id, "FAIL")
    failed = scores(session)
    engine.analyze(session)
    assert scores(session) == failed
    engine.record_test_result(session, test.id, "PASS")
    passed = scores(session)
    assert any(passed[k] < baseline[k] for k in baseline)
    engine.record_test_result(session, test.id, "INCOMPLETE", notes="pressure drops")
    assert scores(session) == baseline


def test_two_distinct_results_accumulate_and_first_survives_second():
    engine, session = case()
    first = session.recommendations[0]
    engine.record_test_result(session, first.id, "FAIL")
    after_first = scores(session)
    second = next(x for x in session.recommendations if set(x.target_hypotheses) & set(first.target_hypotheses))
    engine.record_test_result(session, second.id, "FAIL")
    after_second = scores(session)
    common = set(first.target_hypotheses) & set(second.target_hypotheses)
    assert any(after_second[x] > after_first[x] for x in common if x in after_first)
    engine.analyze(session)
    assert scores(session) == after_second


def test_localized_result_and_normal_analysis_keep_recalculated_scores(monkeypatch):
    from api import intelligence_routes, main
    from diagnostic.localization import localize_session_analysis

    engine, session = case()
    sid = str(session.session_id)
    monkeypatch.setattr(intelligence_routes, "sessions", {sid: session})
    monkeypatch.setattr(main, "sessions", {sid: session})
    test = session.recommendations[0]
    baseline = scores(session)
    response = intelligence_routes.add_test_result(
        sid, intelligence_routes.TestResultRequest(test_id=test.id, result="FAIL"), language="hy")
    assert scores(session) != baseline
    assert sorted(h.confidence_score for h in response.hypotheses) == sorted(scores(session).values())
    changed = scores(session)
    main.analyze(sid, language="ru")
    assert scores(session) == changed
    for language in ("en", "ru", "hy"):
        localized = localize_session_analysis(session, language)
        assert [h.confidence_score for h in localized.hypotheses] == list(changed.values())

class FakeConnection:
    def __init__(self):
        self.calls = []
    def __enter__(self): return self
    def __exit__(self, *args): return False
    def execute(self, statement, params=None):
        self.calls.append((str(statement), params))
        return FakeResult()


class FakeResult:
    def mappings(self):
        return self
    def all(self):
        return [{
            "chunk_id": "chunk-1",
            "document_id": "doc-1",
            "content": "LPG misfire",
            "metadata": {"source": "manual"},
            "score": 0.91,
        }]


class FakeEngine:
    def __init__(self):
        self.connection = FakeConnection()
    @contextmanager
    def begin(self):
        yield self.connection


def test_pgvector_repository_schema_upsert_and_search_without_database(monkeypatch):
    engine = FakeEngine()
    monkeypatch.setattr(vector_store, "create_engine", Mock(return_value=engine))
    repository = vector_store.PgVectorKnowledgeRepository("postgresql://unused")
    repository.ensure_schema(dimensions=384)
    repository.upsert(
        "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001",
        "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002",
        "LPG misfire",
        {"source": "manual"},
        [0.1, 0.2, 0.3],
    )
    hits = repository.search([0.1, 0.2, 0.3], top_k=4)
    assert len(engine.connection.calls) == 4
    assert "CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector" in engine.connection.calls[0][0]
    assert "vector(384)" in engine.connection.calls[1][0]
    assert engine.connection.calls[2][1]["metadata"] == '{"source": "manual"}'
    assert engine.connection.calls[2][1]["embedding"] == "[0.1,0.2,0.3]"
    assert engine.connection.calls[3][1]["top_k"] == 4
    assert hits == [vector_store.VectorHit("chunk-1", "doc-1", "LPG misfire", {"source": "manual"}, 0.91)]

    assert correlated["gateway_correlations"] == 1

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_active_service_handles_missing_topology_route_candidate_filter_and_empty_filter(monkeypatch):
    seen = []

    class FakeEngine:
        def __init__(self, policy=None):
            self.policy = policy

        async def probe_many(self, targets, buses):
            seen.extend(targets)
            return []

    monkeypatch.setattr(active_service_module, "ActiveEcuDiscoveryEngine", FakeEngine)
    service = active_service_module.ActiveNetworkDiscoveryService()
    sid = uuid4()
    passive = VehicleNetworkDiscoveryResult(ecu_candidates=[
        _candidate("one", bus="CAN0"),
        _candidate("two", bus="CAN0", request_id=0x7E1, response_id=0x7E9),
    ])
    # The route refers to a missing target ECU. The service must skip it and
    # still keep probing candidates directly available on the bus.
    bad_topology = VehicleNetworkTopology(
        routes=(GatewayRoute("GW-MISSING", "CAN0", "CAN1", "not-present"),)
    )
    targets = await service.probe_candidates(
        sid, passive, {"CAN0": object()}, bad_topology, candidate_ids=["one"],
    )
    assert targets == []
    assert len(seen) == 1
    assert seen[0].candidate_id == "one"
    assert seen[0].gateway_id is None

    seen.clear()
    # An empty candidate filter intentionally behaves like no filter in this API.
    await service.probe_candidates(sid, passive, {"CAN0": object()}, topology=None, candidate_ids=[])
    assert [item.candidate_id for item in seen] == ["one", "two"]

def make_device(device_id="vci-1", status=None):
    return routes.DeviceDescriptor(

class FakeManager:
    def __init__(self):
        self.devices = {"vci-1": make_device()}
        self.result = make_device()
        self.error = None
        self.calls = []

    def _call(self, name, *args):
        self.calls.append((name, args))
        if self.error:
            raise self.error
        return self.result

    def add_simulator(self):
        return self._call("add_simulator")

    async def scan(self, *args):
        return self._call("scan", *args)

    async def probe_wifi(self, *args):
        return self._call("probe_wifi", *args)

    async def connect(self, *args):

def _summary(sid):

        session_id=sid, pid="RPM", event_type=SignalEventType.STEP_CHANGE,
        start_ms=100, end_ms=200, severity="HIGH",
        message="RPM changed rapidly", evidence_fact="RPM step change",
    )
    return TelemetrySummary(
        session_id=sid, sample_count=2, signal_count=1,
        start_ms=100, end_ms=200, stats=[stat], events=[event],
    )


def _setup(monkeypatch):

    service = TelemetryService()
    monkeypatch.setattr(routes, "sessions", {"s1": session})

def test_simulator_parameter_endpoint_validation_and_adapter_boundary():

    with TestClient(app) as client:
        sid = client.post('/api/v1/sessions').json()['session_id']

import api.state as state


class FakePersistence:
    def __init__(self, *, enabled=False, loaded=None):
        self.enabled = enabled
        self.loaded = loaded or {}
        self.saved_one = []
        self.saved_all = []
    def load(self):
        return dict(self.loaded)
    def save_one(self, key, value):
        self.saved_one.append((key, value))
    def save_all(self, sessions):
        self.saved_all.append(dict(sessions))


def test_registry_mapping_operations_without_persistence(monkeypatch):

    assert registry.get("missing") is None
    assert list(registry) == ["s1"]

    assert list(registry.items()) == [("s1", session)]
    del registry["s1"]
    assert len(registry) == 0

def test_registry_writes_single_and_all_sessions_to_persistence(monkeypatch):

    registry = state.GlobalSessionRegistry()
    session = DiagnosticSession()

    registry._cache["session-2"] = DiagnosticSession()

def test_doctor_checks_actual_backend_provider_not_only_model_file(monkeypatch,tmp_path,backend_provider,backend_available,ready):

    model.parent.mkdir();model.write_bytes(b'path fixture only, not model weights')

    for key in ('LOCAL_LLM_MODEL_PATH','LOCAL_LLM_SERVER_MODEL','LOCAL_LLM_SERVER_PATH'):
        monkeypatch.delenv(key,raising=False)
    paths=[]

    class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        def do_GET(self):
            paths.append(self.path)
            bodies={'/health':{'status':'ok'},'/v1/models':{'data':[{'id':'installed.gguf'}]},
                    '/props':{'default_generation_settings':{'n_ctx':8192}},

def test_local_seed_is_repeatable_and_keeps_user_edits(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    url = f"sqlite:///{tmp_path / 'local.sqlite'}"
    count = prepare_local_database(url, ROOT)
    assert count > 0
    engine = database_engine(url)
    try:
        with Session(engine) as db:
            row = db.scalars(select(VehicleCatalogEntryRow)).first()
            row.source = "user-edited"
            key = row.id
            db.commit()
        assert prepare_local_database(url, ROOT) == 0
        with Session(engine) as db:
            assert db.get(VehicleCatalogEntryRow, key).source == "user-edited"
        monkeypatch.setattr(catalog, "_engine", engine)
        entries = catalog.list_entries()
        stored = [entry for entry in entries if entry["scope"] != "generation-reference-not-vin-fitment"]
        assert len(stored) == count
        assert any(entry["scope"] == "generation-reference-not-vin-fitment" for entry in entries)
        assert all(isinstance(row["fuel"], list) for row in entries)
        assert any(row["chassis"] == "W211" for row in entries)
    finally:
        engine.dispose()

def test_language_aliases_and_localization_helpers_preserve_unknown_values():
    assert normalize_language(None) == "en"
    assert normalize_language(" ARM ") == "hy"
    assert normalize_language("am") == "hy"
    assert normalize_language("RU") == "ru"
    assert normalize_language("fr") == "en"

    assert _localized_evidence_status("measured", "hy") != "measured"
    assert _localized_evidence_status("custom-state", "hy") == "custom-state"
    assert _localized_event("SYMPTOM_ADDED", "hy") != "SYMPTOM_ADDED"
    assert _localized_event("CUSTOM_EVENT", "ru") == "CUSTOM_EVENT"
    assert _localized_hypothesis_targets(["LPG injection", "custom category"], "hy")[1] == "custom category"
    assert _localized_prerequisite("misfire", "hy") != "misfire"
    assert _localized_prerequisite("custom", "ru") == "custom"
    assert _localized_safety_note("Follow LPG system manufacturer procedures.", "hy") != "Follow LPG system manufacturer procedures."
    assert _localized_safety_note("unmapped safety note", "hy") == "unmapped safety note"
    assert _localized_safety_note("unmapped safety note", "en") == "unmapped safety note"
    assert _localized_status("possible:0.75", "hy") != "possible:0.75"
    assert _localized_status("custom:0.1", "ru") == "custom:0.1"
    assert _localized_status("possible:0.75", "en") == "possible:0.75"
    question = "What is LPG gas pressure at idle and during the reported load/RPM window?"
    assert _localized_question(question, "hy") != question
    assert _localized_question("custom question", "ru") == "custom question"


def test_test_result_evidence_supports_legacy_detailed_id_and_unmatched_shapes():
    legacy = _localized_test_result_fact("Test T12 result: PASS", "hy")
    assert "T12" in legacy and "ԱՆՑԱՎ" in legacy

    detailed = _localized_test_result_fact(
        "Completed diagnostic test: Measure LPG pressure; result: FAIL; technician notes: below spec",
        "ru",
    )
    assert "Measure LPG pressure" in detailed

    id_form = _localized_test_result_fact(
