    assert _localized_evidence_fact("Test abcdef12 result: PASS", "en") == "Test abcdef12 result: PASS"


def test_localize_session_analysis_translates_nested_fields_without_mutating_source():
    session = DiagnosticSession()
    session.hypotheses = [
        Hypothesis(category="LPG injection", statement="Check injectors", status="possible:0.85")
    ]
    session.recommendations = [
        DiagnosticTest(
            name="Measure LPG pressure at idle and under load",
            purpose="Check pressure",
            safety_notes=[
                "Follow LPG system manufacturer procedures.",
                "unknown note",
            ],
            prerequisites=["misfire", "custom prerequisite"],
            target_hypotheses=["LPG injection", "custom hypothesis"],
        )
    ]
    session.test_results = [
        TestResult(
            test_id=session.recommendations[0].id,
            result="PASS",
            test_name="Measure LPG pressure at idle and under load",
        )
    ]
    session.evidence = [
        Evidence(
            fact="Completed diagnostic test: Measure LPG pressure at idle and under load; result: PASS; technician notes: stable",
            source=EvidenceSource.TECHNICIAN_OBSERVED,
            status=EvidenceStatus.MEASURED,
        ),
        Evidence(
            fact=f"Test {session.recommendations[0].id} result: INCOMPLETE",
            source=EvidenceSource.TECHNICIAN_OBSERVED,
            status=EvidenceStatus.MEASURED,
        ),
    ]
    session.audit_log = [
        {
            "event": "SYMPTOM_ADDED",
            "questions": ["What is LPG gas pressure at idle and during the reported load/RPM window?", "custom question"],
        },
        {"event": "CUSTOM_EVENT"},
    ]

    localized = localize_session_analysis(session, "arm")
    assert localized is not session
    assert localized.hypotheses[0].category != session.hypotheses[0].category
    assert localized.hypotheses[0].status != session.hypotheses[0].status
    assert localized.recommendations[0].name != session.recommendations[0].name
    assert localized.recommendations[0].safety_notes[1] == "unknown note"
    assert localized.recommendations[0].prerequisites[1] == "custom prerequisite"
    assert localized.recommendations[0].target_hypotheses[1] == "custom hypothesis"
    assert localized.test_results[0].result == "PASS"
    assert localized.test_results[0].result_label == "ԱՆՑԱՎ"
    assert "stable" in localized.evidence[0].fact
    assert "ԱՆԱՎԱՐՏ" in localized.evidence[1].fact
    assert localized.audit_log[0]["event"] != "SYMPTOM_ADDED"
    assert localized.audit_log[0]["questions"][1] == "custom question"
    assert localized.audit_log[1]["event"] == "CUSTOM_EVENT"

    # English is intentionally a deep-copied identity result.
    english = localize_session_analysis(session, "en")
    assert english is not session
    assert english.hypotheses[0].category == session.hypotheses[0].category


@pytest.mark.parametrize("language", ["hy", "ru"])
def test_localized_dtc_and_structured_facts_keep_source_session_unchanged(language):
    from diagnostic.models import DTC, DiagnosticSession, Evidence, EvidenceSource, EvidenceStatus
    from diagnostic.localization import localize_session_analysis
    session = DiagnosticSession(dtcs=[DTC(code="P0302"), DTC(code="P0171", description="Technician original note")])
    session.evidence.append(Evidence(fact="fuel_mode_lpg", source=EvidenceSource.USER_REPORTED, status=EvidenceStatus.REPORTED, metadata={"derived_from": "on LPG"}))
    localized = localize_session_analysis(session, language)
    assert localized.dtcs[0].description
    assert localized.dtcs[1].description == "Technician original note"
    assert localized.evidence[0].fact != "fuel_mode_lpg"
    assert localized.evidence[0].source == EvidenceSource.USER_REPORTED
    assert session.dtcs[0].description is None
    assert session.evidence[0].fact == "fuel_mode_lpg"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("language", ["hy", "ru"])
def test_entire_decision_plan_presentation_is_localized(language):
    from diagnostic.decision import CATALOG, DecisionCandidate, DiagnosticDecisionPlan
    from diagnostic.localization import localize_decision_plan
    from uuid import uuid4
    candidates = [DecisionCandidate(test_id=uuid4(), name=spec.name, purpose=spec.purpose, priority_score=.5, information_gain=.5, evidence_fit=.5, cost_penalty=.1, risk_penalty=.1, safety_notes=list(spec.safety_notes), rationale=["Required evidence is present.", "Estimated information gain: 0.50.", "Targets ignition."]) for spec in CATALOG]
    plan = DiagnosticDecisionPlan(session_id=uuid4(), state="TESTING", candidates=candidates)
    localized = localize_decision_plan(plan, language)
    for original, translated in zip(plan.candidates, localized.candidates):
        assert original.test_id == translated.test_id
        assert original.name != translated.name
        assert original.purpose != translated.purpose
        assert original.rationale != translated.rationale
        assert original.safety_notes != translated.safety_notes

import logging

from diagnostic.models import DiagnosticSession, Vehicle
import diagnostic.session_persistence as persistence_module
from diagnostic.session_persistence import DiagnosticSessionPersistence, DiagnosticSessionStateRow


def _session(model: str = "W211") -> DiagnosticSession:
    return DiagnosticSession(vehicle=Vehicle(make="Mercedes-Benz", model=model, year=2006))


def test_disabled_persistence_is_a_safe_noop(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.delenv("DATABASE_URL", raising=False)
    store = DiagnosticSessionPersistence()

    assert store.enabled is False
    assert store.load() == {}
    store.save_one("unused", _session())
    store.save_all({"unused": _session()})
    store.close()
    assert store.engine is None


def test_save_one_inserts_then_updates_and_save_all_upserts(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("DATABASE_URL", f"sqlite:///{tmp_path / 'sessions.sqlite'}")
    store = DiagnosticSessionPersistence()
    try:
        first = _session()
        store.save_one("first", first)
        first.vehicle.model = "W211 updated"
        store.save_one("first", first)
        second = _session("W245")
        store.save_all({"first": first, "second": second})

        restored = store.load()
        assert restored["first"].vehicle.model == "W211 updated"
        assert restored["second"].vehicle.model == "W245"
    finally:
        store.close()
    assert store.engine is None


def test_load_skips_invalid_rows_but_keeps_valid_sessions(tmp_path, monkeypatch, caplog):
    monkeypatch.setenv("DATABASE_URL", f"sqlite:///{tmp_path / 'invalid.sqlite'}")
    store = DiagnosticSessionPersistence()
    try:
        valid = _session()
        store.save_one("valid", valid)
        with persistence_module.DbSession(store.engine) as db:
            db.add(DiagnosticSessionStateRow(session_id="invalid", payload={"vehicle": {"make": "missing-model"}}))
            db.commit()

        with caplog.at_level(logging.ERROR, logger=persistence_module.__name__):
            restored = store.load()

        assert list(restored) == ["valid"]
        assert "Skipping invalid persisted session invalid" in caplog.text
    finally:
        store.close()


def test_load_returns_empty_when_database_session_fails(monkeypatch, caplog):
    class BrokenDb:
        def __enter__(self):
            raise RuntimeError("database unavailable")

        def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc, traceback):
            return False

    monkeypatch.delenv("DATABASE_URL", raising=False)
    store = DiagnosticSessionPersistence()
    store.enabled = True
    store.engine = object()
    monkeypatch.setattr(persistence_module, "DbSession", lambda _engine: BrokenDb())

    with caplog.at_level(logging.ERROR, logger=persistence_module.__name__):
        assert store.load() == {}
    assert "Failed to load persisted diagnostic sessions" in caplog.text


def test_save_all_swallows_database_errors_and_close_disposes(monkeypatch, caplog):
    class BrokenDb:
        def __enter__(self):
            raise RuntimeError("write failed")

        def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc, traceback):
            return False

    class Engine:
        def __init__(self):
            self.disposed = False

        def dispose(self):
            self.disposed = True

    monkeypatch.delenv("DATABASE_URL", raising=False)
    store = DiagnosticSessionPersistence()
    engine = Engine()
    store.enabled = True
    store.engine = engine
    monkeypatch.setattr(persistence_module, "DbSession", lambda _engine: BrokenDb())

    with caplog.at_level(logging.ERROR, logger=persistence_module.__name__):
        store.save_all({"s": _session()})
    assert "Failed to persist diagnostic sessions" in caplog.text

    store.close()
    assert engine.disposed is True
    assert store.engine is None

    if condition == 'expired-invite':
        with Session(engine) as db:
            db.get(Invitation,invitation).expires_at=utcnow()-timedelta(days=1);db.commit()
        assert client.post(P+f'/invitations/{invitation}/accept',headers=owner_h,json={'profile_id':profile}).status_code==403
        return
    if condition == 'foreign-profile':
        foreign=vehicle(client,tech_h)
        assert client.post(P+f'/invitations/{invitation}/accept',headers=owner_h,json={'profile_id':foreign}).status_code==404
        return
    result=client.post(P+f'/invitations/{invitation}/accept',headers=owner_h,json={'profile_id':profile})
    assert result.status_code==200,result.text
    with Session(engine) as db:
        grant=db.get(Consent,result.json()['id'])
        if condition=='expired-grant':grant.expires_at=utcnow()-timedelta(seconds=1)
        if condition=='inactive-staff':db.get(Staff,(center,tech)).active=False
        if condition=='inactive-owner':db.get(Account,owner).active=False
        if condition=='missing-scope':grant.scopes=['report:read']
        if condition=='inactive-center':db.get(ServiceCenter,center).active=False
        if condition=='revoked-customer-role':db.delete(db.get(AccountRole,(tech,'CUSTOMER')))
        db.commit()
    if condition=='already-accepted':
        assert client.post(P+f'/invitations/{invitation}/accept',headers=owner_h,json={'profile_id':profile}).status_code==409
    else:
        expected = 403 if condition == 'revoked-customer-role' else 404
        assert client.get(P+f'/service-centers/{center}/vehicles/{profile}',headers=tech_h).status_code==expected

def test_recorded_test_is_removed_and_remaining_priorities_are_recalculated():
    engine = DiagnosticIntelligenceEngine()
    session = engine.analyze(_session())
    completed_test = engine.next_test(session)
    assert completed_test is not None
    previous_scores = {item.name: item.priority_score for item in session.recommendations}

    result = engine.record_test_result(
        session,
        completed_test.id,
        "PASS",
        measurements={"pressure_kpa": 110},
        notes="pressure stable and within specification",
    )

    remaining = {item.name: item for item in result.recommendations}
    assert completed_test.name not in remaining
    assert result.test_results[-1].test_name == completed_test.name
    assert remaining
    assert any(
        abs(previous_scores[name] - item.priority_score) > 0.0001
        for name, item in remaining.items()
        if name in previous_scores
    )


def test_completed_rule_test_does_not_reappear_with_regenerated_id():
    engine = DiagnosticIntelligenceEngine()
    # Empty catalog forces the rules-only fallback, whose tests receive new
    # UUIDs when analysis runs again.
    engine.decision = DiagnosticDecisionEngine(catalog=())
    session = engine.analyze(_session())
    completed_test = engine.next_test(session)
    assert completed_test is not None

    result = engine.record_test_result(
        session,
        completed_test.id,
        "FAIL",
        measurements={"observed": True},
        notes="symptom reproduced under the same load",
    )

    assert result.test_results[-1].test_name == completed_test.name
    assert completed_test.name not in {item.name for item in result.recommendations}
    assert result.recommendations
    assert result.recommendations == sorted(
        result.recommendations,
        key=lambda item: (
            -item.priority_score,
            {"LOW": 0, "MEDIUM": 1, "HIGH": 2}.get(item.risk_level.upper(), 3),
            item.estimated_cost,
            item.name,
        ),
    )



@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "outcome,notes,expected_status",
    [
        ("PASS", "pressure drops", "disfavored_by_test"),
        ("FAIL", "pressure stable", "supported_by_test"),
        ("INCOMPLETE", "symptom reproduced", None),
    ],
)
def test_explicit_test_outcome_takes_precedence_over_conflicting_notes(
    outcome, notes, expected_status
):
    engine = DiagnosticIntelligenceEngine()
    session = engine.analyze(_session())
    test = engine.next_test(session)
    assert test is not None

    engine.decision.update_hypotheses_from_result(session, test, f"{outcome} {notes}")
    targeted = [
        hypothesis for hypothesis in session.hypotheses
        if hypothesis.category in test.target_hypotheses
    ]
    assert targeted
    if expected_status is None:
        assert all(
            hypothesis.status not in {"supported_by_test", "disfavored_by_test"}
            for hypothesis in targeted
        )
    else:
        assert all(hypothesis.status == expected_status for hypothesis in targeted)

from time import perf_counter

from diagnostic.models import DiagnosticSession, DTC, Symptom, Vehicle
from ai.reasoning.engine import DiagnosticIntelligenceEngine


def _case_session() -> DiagnosticSession:
    return DiagnosticSession(
        vehicle=Vehicle(
            make="Mercedes-Benz",
            model="W211 E350",
            year=2006,
            engine="M272 3.5",
            fuel=["petrol", "LPG"],
            ecu="ME 9.7",
        ),
        symptoms=[Symptom(raw_text="Engine shakes on LPG below 2000 RPM under load; petrol is normal.")],
        dtcs=[DTC(code="P0302")],
    )


def test_deterministic_analysis_performance_budget():
    engine = DiagnosticIntelligenceEngine()
    session = _case_session()
    for _ in range(10):
        engine.analyze(session.model_copy(deep=True))

    timings = []
    for _ in range(100):
        started = perf_counter()
        engine.analyze(session.model_copy(deep=True))
        timings.append((perf_counter() - started) * 1000)

    timings.sort()
    p50 = timings[len(timings) // 2]
    p95 = timings[max(0, int(len(timings) * 0.95) - 1)]
    print(f"PERF deterministic_analysis_ms p50={p50:.2f} p95={p95:.2f} min={min(timings):.2f} max={max(timings):.2f}")
    assert p95 < 90.0, f"p50={p50:.2f}ms p95={p95:.2f}ms"

def test_real_http_retry_timeout_redirect_and_invalid_contract(tmp_path, monkeypatch, scenario):
    import time
    class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        attempts=0
        def do_GET(self):
            type(self).attempts+=1
            assert self.headers['Authorization']=='Bearer '+TOKEN
            if scenario=='timeout':time.sleep(.3)
            status=503 if scenario=='retry' and self.attempts==1 else 302 if scenario=='redirect' else 200
            self.send_response(status)
            if scenario=='redirect':self.send_header('Location','http://127.0.0.1:9/credential-leak')
            self.end_headers()

            except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError):pass
        def log_message(self,*_):pass
    server=ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),Handler);server.daemon_threads=True

import asyncio
import struct

import pytest
from fastapi import HTTPException

def packet(kind, payload=b''):
    return struct.pack('!BBHI', 2, 253, kind, len(payload)) + payload


async def receive(reader):
    _, _, kind, size = struct.unpack('!BBHI', await reader.readexactly(8))
    return kind, await reader.readexactly(size)


@pytest.mark.asyncio
@pytest.mark.parametrize('service', ['vin', 'dtcs', 'mismatch', 'negative', 'nack', 'routing_rejected', 'bad_header', 'oversized', 'timeout'])
async def test_doip_real_tcp_routing_and_read_only_exchange(service):
    seen = []
    finished = asyncio.Event()

    async def gateway(reader, writer):
        try:
            kind, body = await receive(reader)
            seen.append((kind, body))
            activation = struct.pack('!HHB4x', 0x0E00, 1, 0 if service == 'routing_rejected' else 0x10)
            writer.write(packet(6, activation)); await writer.drain()
            if service == 'routing_rejected': return
            kind, body = await receive(reader); seen.append((kind, body))
            assert body[:4] == b'\x0E\x00\x00\x01'
            request = body[4:]
            if service == 'timeout':
                await reader.read()
                return
            if service == 'bad_header': writer.write(b'\x02\x00\x80\x01\x00\x00\x00\x05')
            elif service == 'oversized': writer.write(struct.pack('!BBHI', 2, 253, 0x8001, 65537))
            elif service == 'nack': writer.write(packet(0x8003, b'\x00\x01\x0E\x00\x02'))
            else:
                addresses = b'\x00\x01\x0E\x00'
                writer.write(packet(7)); await writer.drain()
                assert await receive(reader) == (8, b'\x0E\x00')
                writer.write(packet(0x8002, addresses + b'\x00'))
                writer.write(packet(0x8001, addresses + bytes((127, request[0], 120))))
                if service == 'negative': response = b'\x7F\x22\x31'
                elif service == 'mismatch': response = b'\x62\xF1\x91WRONG'
                elif service == 'dtcs': response = b'\x59\x02\xFF\x03\x02\x00\x08'
                else: response = b'\x62\xF1\x90WDBUF56X06B123456'
                frame = packet(0x8001, addresses + response)
                writer.write(frame[:5]); await writer.drain()
                writer.write(frame[5:])
            await writer.drain()
        except (ConnectionError, asyncio.IncompleteReadError):
            pass
        finally:
            writer.close(); await writer.wait_closed(); finished.set()

    server = await asyncio.start_server(gateway, '127.0.0.1', 0)
    port = server.sockets[0].getsockname()[1]
    try:
        request = DoipRead(host='127.0.0.1', port=port, source_address=0x0E00, target_address=1,
                           timeout=0.2 if service == 'timeout' else 2,
                           **({'dtc_status_mask': 255} if service == 'dtcs' else {'did': 0xF190}))
        if service in {'vin', 'dtcs'}:
            result = await read_doip(request)
            assert result['read_only'] and not result['hardware_verified']
            assert result['response_hex'].startswith('5902' if service == 'dtcs' else '62F190')
        else:
            with pytest.raises(HTTPException) as error: await read_doip(request)
            assert error.value.status_code == 502
        assert seen[0] == (5, b'\x0E\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00')
        assert all(frame[0] in (5, 0x8001) for frame in seen)
        await asyncio.wait_for(finished.wait(), 2)
    finally:
        server.close(); await server.wait_closed()

    commands = []
    finished = asyncio.Event()

        try:
            while raw := await reader.readuntil(b'\r'):
                command = raw.decode().strip()
                commands.append(command)
                if command == '0100': response = '4100BE' if mode == 'bad_bitmap' else '4100BE1FA813'
                elif command == 'ATDPN': response = 'A3' if mode == 'kline' else 'A7' if mode == 'extended' else 'A6'
                elif command.startswith('ATSH') and mode == 'adapter_rejected': response = '?'
                elif command == '22F190':
                    response = ('62F19100' if mode == 'wrong_did' else '7F2231' if mode == 'negative'
                                else '62F1905744425546353658303642313233343536')
                elif command == '1902FF': response = '5902FF03020008'
                elif command == '010C': response = '410C1AF8'
                else: response = command+'\rOK' if command == 'ATE0' else 'OK'
                writer.write((response+'>').encode()); await writer.drain()
        except (asyncio.IncompleteReadError, ConnectionError): pass
        finally:
            writer.close(); await writer.wait_closed(); finished.set()

    server = await asyncio.start_server(adapter,'127.0.0.1',0)
    transport = ObdWifiTransport('127.0.0.1',server.sockets[0].getsockname()[1])
    client = GenericObdClient(transport,protocol_id='can-29-500' if mode == 'extended' else 'can-11-500')

        else:

                await client.read_uds(0x1000 if mode == 'bad_width' else 0x7E0,0x7E8,command)
        if mode not in {'bad_bitmap','kline','bad_width'}:
            assert commands.count('ATSP7' if mode == 'extended' else 'ATSP6') == 2
            assert commands[-1] == '0100'
            assert ('ATSH18DA10F1' if mode == 'extended' else 'ATSH7E0') in commands
        assert await client.read_pid(12) == bytes.fromhex('1AF8')
    finally:
        await client.disconnect(); server.close(); await server.wait_closed()
        await asyncio.wait_for(finished.wait(),2)

def test_real_tcp_transport_is_used_by_backend_device_facade():
    from device.manager import VCIConnectionManager
    async def scenario():
        commands = []
        async def adapter(reader, writer):
            try:
                while data := await reader.readuntil(b'\r'):
                    command = data.decode().strip(); commands.append(command)
                    reply = {'010C':'410C1AF8','0100':'4100BE1FA813','ATDPN':'A6'}.get(command,'OK')
                    writer.write((reply+'>').encode()); await writer.drain()
            except (asyncio.IncompleteReadError, ConnectionError): pass
            finally:
                writer.close(); await writer.wait_closed()
        server = await asyncio.start_server(adapter,'127.0.0.1',0)
        manager = VCIConnectionManager()
        try:
            port = server.sockets[0].getsockname()[1]
            descriptor = await manager.probe_wifi('127.0.0.1',port,1)

            assert 'ATSP6' in commands
            observed = await manager._physical().connected_obd(descriptor.device_id).protocol_status()
            assert observed['id'] == 'can-11-500'
        finally:
            await manager.shutdown(); server.close(); await server.wait_closed()
    asyncio.run(scenario())

class TracedTransport(SimulatorTransport):
    def __init__(self, responses):
        super().__init__(responses)
        self.commands = []

    async def write(self, data):
        self.commands.append(data.decode().strip())
        await super().write(data)

async def test_local_reader_polls_only_supported_pids_and_refreshes_on_reconnect():
    transport = TracedTransport({"0100":bitmap(12), "010C":"410C1F40", "0105":"41057B"})

    try:
        await client.connect()
        first = await client.read_standard_live_data()
        second = await client.read_standard_live_data()
        assert first["rpm"] == second["rpm"] == 2000
        assert first["coolant_c"] is None
        assert transport.commands.count("0100") == 1
        assert transport.commands.count("010C") == 2
        assert "0105" not in transport.commands
        await client.disconnect()
        transport.responses["0100"] = bitmap(5)
        await client.connect()
        start = len(transport.commands)
        changed = await client.read_standard_live_data()
        assert changed["coolant_c"] == 83
        assert changed["rpm"] is None
        assert transport.commands[start:] == ["0105"]
    finally:

"""Numerical/event regression against the unchanged standalone analysis contracts."""
import random
from uuid import UUID
import pytest
from telemetry.analysis import compute_stats, detect_events
from telemetry.models import TelemetrySample, TelemetrySummary
from telemetry.channels import channel_name
from telemetry.service import TelemetryService


def canonical(summary):
    data=summary.model_dump(mode='json');data.pop('generated_at')
    for event in data['events']:event.pop('id')
    return data


def original_summary(service,sid):
    items=service.samples(sid);grouped={}
    for item in items:grouped.setdefault(item.pid,[]).append(item)
    stats=[];events=[]
    for pid,samples in sorted(grouped.items()):
        stat=compute_stats(sid,pid,samples);signal_events=detect_events(sid,pid,samples)
        stat.display_name=channel_name(pid);stat.event_count=len(signal_events)
        stat.anomaly_count=sum(e.event_type.value in {'STEP_CHANGE','RATE_SPIKE','OUT_OF_RANGE'} for e in signal_events)
        stats.append(stat);events.extend(signal_events)
    return TelemetrySummary(session_id=sid,sample_count=len(items),signal_count=len(grouped),
        start_ms=items[0].timestamp_ms if items else None,end_ms=items[-1].timestamp_ms if items else None,stats=stats,events=events)


@pytest.mark.parametrize('seed',range(12))
@pytest.mark.parametrize('count',[0,1,2,127,1024])
def test_summary_exact_equivalence(seed,count):
    rng=random.Random(seed);sid=UUID(int=42);other=UUID(int=43);service=TelemetryService()
    samples=[TelemetrySample(session_id=sid,pid=rng.choice(['rpm','map','coolant_temp','unknown']),
        timestamp_ms=rng.randrange(20)*100,value=rng.choice([-100.,0.,.1,95.,1e4]),
        quality=rng.choice(['GOOD','SUSPECT','INVALID']),sequence=rng.choice([None,0,1,3])) for _ in range(count)]
    service.append(samples+[TelemetrySample(session_id=other,pid='rpm',timestamp_ms=0,value=42)])
    before=[s.model_dump() for s in samples]
    assert canonical(service.summarize(sid))==canonical(original_summary(service,sid))
    assert [s.model_dump() for s in samples]==before
    assert service.summarize(other).sample_count==1


def test_append_recomputes_and_does_not_return_shared_cached_models():
    sid=UUID(int=42);service=TelemetryService()
    service.append([TelemetrySample(session_id=sid,pid='rpm',timestamp_ms=200,value=800,quality='INVALID')])
    first=service.summarize(sid)
    assert first.sample_count==1 and first.stats[0].count==0
    first.stats[0].count=99
    service.append([TelemetrySample(session_id=sid,pid='rpm',timestamp_ms=100,value=1000)])
    second=service.summarize(sid)
    assert second.sample_count==2 and second.stats[0].count==1
    assert second.start_ms==100 and second.end_ms==200

def _membership(role: Role, active: bool = True) -> Membership:

        require_role(_membership(Role.OWNER, active=False), Role.VIEWER)
    with pytest.raises(AuthorizationError, match="cannot perform"):
        require_role(_membership(Role.VIEWER), Role.TECHNICIAN)

    [
        (Role.VIEWER, False, False),

        (Role.OWNER, True, True),

)

from __future__ import annotations

from argparse import Namespace
import hashlib
import json

import pytest

import importlib.util

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("unified_native_build", Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "scripts/build_all.py")
build = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(build)


def arguments(tmp_path, **overrides):
    values = dict(targets=list(build.TARGETS), output=tmp_path / "artifacts", check=False,
                  skip_unavailable=False, with_tests=False, no_install=True,apps=["user"],android_api_url=None)
    values.update(overrides)
    return Namespace(**values)


def summary(tmp_path):
    return json.loads(next((tmp_path / "artifacts").glob("*/build-summary.json")).read_text())


def fake_package(args, runner, work, output, tools):
    artifact = output / "package.zip"
    artifact.write_bytes(b"valid build output")
    return [artifact]


def test_one_failed_target_does_not_hide_successful_independent_builds(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
    monkeypatch.setattr(build, "REPO", tmp_path)
    monkeypatch.setattr(build, "preflight", lambda target: [])
    def failed(*_args):
        raise build.BuildError("compiler exit 7")
    monkeypatch.setattr(build, "BUILDERS", {"desktop": fake_package, "android": failed, "ios": fake_package})
    assert build.execute(arguments(tmp_path)) == 1
    report = summary(tmp_path)
    assert report["status"] == "FAIL"
    assert report["targets"]["desktop"]["status"] == "PASS"
    assert report["targets"]["ios"]["status"] == "PASS"
    assert report["targets"]["android"]["artifacts"] == []
    assert "compiler exit 7" in report["targets"]["android"]["error"]

    forbidden = Mock(side_effect=AssertionError("unsupported build must not run"))
    monkeypatch.setattr(build, "BUILDERS", {"desktop": fake_package, "android": fake_package, "ios": forbidden})
    assert build.execute(arguments(tmp_path, skip_unavailable=allow_partial)) == expected_exit
    result = summary(tmp_path)
    assert result["status"] == "PARTIAL"
    assert result["targets"]["ios"]["status"] == "UNAVAILABLE"
    forbidden.assert_not_called()

"""Cleanup must never reach tracked data, native outputs or linked directories."""
from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
import subprocess
import sys

import pytest

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('safe_repo_cleanup', Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'scripts/clean_repository.py')
clean = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
sys.modules[spec.name] = clean
spec.loader.exec_module(clean)


def write(root, relative):
    path = root / relative
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text('test')
    return path


def test_cleanup_preserves_user_files_builds_models_envs_and_tracked_caches(tmp_path):
    cache = write(tmp_path, 'apps/__pycache__/module.pyc')
    coverage = write(tmp_path, 'finalbuild/.coverage')
    preserved = [write(tmp_path, relative) for relative in [
        'build/__pycache__/packaged.pyc', '.venv/__pycache__/installed.pyc',
        '.build-tools/desktop-venv/__pycache__/installed.pyc',
        'artifacts/run/.coverage', 'models/.coverage', 'assets/.coverage',
        'desktop-test-reports/summary.json', 'backend.log', 'notes.tmp',
        'fixtures/__pycache__/tracked.pyc',
    ]]
    plan = clean.candidates(tmp_path, frozenset({'fixtures/__pycache__/tracked.pyc'}))
    assert {c.path for c in plan} == {cache.parent, coverage}
    for candidate in plan: clean.remove(tmp_path, candidate)
    assert not cache.exists() and not coverage.exists()
    assert all(path.exists() for path in preserved)


def test_directory_links_and_links_inside_caches_do_not_remove_targets(tmp_path):
    outside = tmp_path / 'external'
    outside.mkdir()
    important = write(outside, 'notes.txt')
    root = tmp_path / 'repo'; root.mkdir()
    try: (root / '__pycache__').symlink_to(outside, target_is_directory=True)
    except OSError: pytest.skip('Symlinks unavailable')
    assert clean.candidates(root, frozenset()) == []
    with pytest.raises(ValueError): clean.remove(root, clean.Candidate(root / '__pycache__', 0))
    (root / '__pycache__').unlink()
    write(root, '__pycache__/module.pyc')
    (root / '__pycache__/linked').symlink_to(outside, target_is_directory=True)
    plan = clean.candidates(root, frozenset())
    assert plan[0].bytes == 4
    clean.remove(root, plan[0])
    assert important.read_text() == 'test'


def test_cleanup_rejects_root_and_external_candidates(tmp_path):
    root = tmp_path / 'repo'; root.mkdir()
    external = write(tmp_path, 'outside.txt')
    for path in (root, external):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError): clean.remove(root, clean.Candidate(path, 4))
    assert external.exists()


def test_preview_is_default_and_apply_removes_only_proposed_cache(monkeypatch, tmp_path, capsys):
    write(tmp_path, '__pycache__/code.pyc')
    monkeypatch.setattr(clean, 'ROOT', tmp_path)
    monkeypatch.setattr(clean, 'tracked_paths', lambda _: frozenset())
    assert clean.main([]) == 0
    assert (tmp_path / '__pycache__').exists()
    assert 'Preview:' in capsys.readouterr().out
    assert clean.main(['--apply']) == 0
    assert not (tmp_path / '__pycache__').exists()
    assert 'Removed:' in capsys.readouterr().out


def test_git_tracked_cache_remains_protected(tmp_path):
    subprocess.run(['git', 'init', '-q', str(tmp_path)], check=True)

class Response(BytesIO):
    def __init__(self, value, status=200, headers=None):
        super().__init__(value); self.status=status;self.headers=headers or {}
    def geturl(self): return 'https://downloads.test/artifact'


def write(path, data=b'test'):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True);path.write_bytes(data);return path

        return Response(payload[4:],206,{'Content-Range':f'bytes 4-{len(payload)-1}/{len(payload)}'})
    monkeypatch.setattr(runner.urllib.request,'urlopen',opened)
    runner.download('https://downloads.test/model',target,hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(),size=len(payload))

import asyncio
from uuid import uuid4

import pytest

from acquisition.models import AcquisitionStartRequest
from acquisition.service import AcquisitionApiService
from api.telemetry_routes import service as telemetry_service


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_simulator_acquisition_emits_records_updates_status_and_stops(monkeypatch):
    appended = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(telemetry_service, "append", lambda samples: appended.extend(samples) or len(samples))
    service = AcquisitionApiService()
    sid = uuid4()
    status = await service.start_simulator(
        sid, AcquisitionStartRequest(poll_interval_ms=20, pids=[0x0C, 0x99])
    )
    assert status.state == "RUNNING"
    assert status.adapter == "simulator"
    assert status.stats["polls"] == 0

    await asyncio.sleep(0.055)
    mid = service.status(sid)
    assert mid.stats["polls"] >= 1
    assert mid.buffered_records >= 2
    records = service.snapshot(sid, 2)
    assert records[-1].channel == "0x99"
    assert records[-1].numeric_value == 0.0
    assert records[-1].unit is None
    assert appended
    assert all(sample.session_id == sid for sample in appended)

    # Starting an already-running task reuses it and does not reset its counters.
    previous_polls = service.status(sid).stats["polls"]
    repeated = await service.start_simulator(sid, AcquisitionStartRequest(poll_interval_ms=20, pids=[0x0C]))
    assert repeated.stats["polls"] == previous_polls

    stopped = await service.stop(sid)
    assert stopped.state == "STOPPED"
    assert service.status(sid).state == "STOPPED"
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        service.status(uuid4())

def _load_module(name: str, relative: str):

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_simulated_can_bus_tx_rx_hooks_timeouts_and_empty_tx_queue():
    bus = SimulatedCanBus()
    assert bus.pop_tx() is None
    assert await bus.receive(timeout_ms=1) is None

    seen_tx = []
    seen_rx = []
    async def async_tx(frame):
        await asyncio.sleep(0)
        seen_tx.append(frame.arbitration_id)
    def sync_rx(frame):
        seen_rx.append(frame.arbitration_id)

    bus.add_tx_hook(async_tx)
    bus.add_rx_hook(sync_rx)
    tx = CanFrame(0x7E0, b"\x01\x03")
    await bus.send(tx)
    assert bus.pop_tx() == tx
    assert seen_tx == [0x7E0]

    rx = CanFrame(0x7E8, b"\x02\x41\x0C")
    bus.inject(rx)
    assert seen_rx == [0x7E8]
    assert await bus.receive(timeout_ms=10) == rx

    async_rx = []
    async def async_rx_hook(frame):
        await asyncio.sleep(0)
        async_rx.append(frame.arbitration_id)
    bus.add_rx_hook(async_rx_hook)
    bus.inject(CanFrame(0x7E9, b"\\x01"))
    await asyncio.sleep(0.001)
    assert async_rx == [0x7E9]

def test_simulated_can_bus_closes_async_hook_when_injected_without_event_loop():
    bus = SimulatedCanBus()
    calls = []

    async def async_hook(frame):
        calls.append(frame.arbitration_id)

    bus.add_rx_hook(async_hook)
    # A synchronous caller cannot schedule an async hook; the implementation
    # must close the unused coroutine and avoid a RuntimeWarning.
    bus.inject(CanFrame(0x7E8, b"\\x01"))
    assert calls == []

def load(name, path):

def snapshot(extra=None, runner_code=None):

import asyncio
from types import SimpleNamespace
from uuid import uuid4

import pytest

from vehicle.acquisition.manager import AcquisitionManager
from vehicle.acquisition.models import AcquisitionState
from vehicle.acquisition.sources import ObdPollingSource
from vehicle.obd.protocols.elm327 import ELM327Protocol


class DroppingClient:
    def __init__(self):
        self.transport = SimpleNamespace(connected=False)
        self.protocol = ELM327Protocol()
        self.reads = 0
        self.connects = 0

    async def connect(self):
        self.connects += 1
        self.transport.connected = True

    async def disconnect(self):
        self.transport.connected = False

    async def read_pid(self, pid):
        self.reads += 1
        if self.reads == 1:
            self.transport.connected = False
            raise ConnectionError("adapter unplugged")
        return b"\x1f\x40"


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_transport_disconnect_reaches_manager_and_recovers_readings():
    client = DroppingClient()
    delivered = asyncio.Event()
    manager = AcquisitionManager(ObdPollingSource(client, [0x0C]), session_id=uuid4(),
                                 poll_interval_s=0.001, sink=lambda rows: delivered.set())
    try:
        await manager.start()
        await asyncio.wait_for(delivered.wait(), timeout=1)
        assert manager.stats["reconnects"] == 1
        assert client.connects == 2
        assert manager.snapshot()[-1].numeric_value == 2000
        assert manager.snapshot()[-1].quality != "INVALID"
    finally:
        await manager.stop()
    assert not client.transport.connected
    assert manager.state == AcquisitionState.STOPPED


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_stop_cancels_a_blocked_read_and_closes_the_adapter():
    class BlockedSource:
        def __init__(self):
            self.reading = asyncio.Event()
            self.closed = False

        async def connect(self):
            pass

        async def read_once(self, session_id, sequence):
            self.reading.set()
            await asyncio.Event().wait()

        async def disconnect(self):
            self.closed = True

    source = BlockedSource()
    manager = AcquisitionManager(source, session_id=uuid4())
    await manager.start()
    await asyncio.wait_for(source.reading.wait(), timeout=1)
    await asyncio.wait_for(manager.stop(), timeout=0.5)
    assert source.closed
    assert manager.state == AcquisitionState.STOPPED


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_unsupported_pid_does_not_trigger_a_transport_reconnect():
    client = DroppingClient()
    async def unsupported(pid):
        raise ValueError("NO DATA")
    client.read_pid = unsupported
    source = ObdPollingSource(client, [0x0C])
    await source.connect()
    try:
        rows = await source.read_once(uuid4(), 0)
        assert rows[0].quality == "INVALID"
        assert client.transport.connected
        assert client.connects == 1
    finally:
        await source.disconnect()

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_obd_polling_source(responses):
    source=ObdPollingSource(GenericObdClient(SimulatorTransport(responses)))
    await source.connect()
    records=await source.read_once(uuid4(),0)
    await source.disconnect()
    assert {r.channel for r in records} == {'rpm','coolant_c','speed_kmh','throttle_percent'}
    assert next(r.numeric_value for r in records if r.channel=='rpm') == 750.0

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_manager_buffers_and_stops(responses):
    sink=[]
    async def collect(records): sink.extend(records)
    source=ObdPollingSource(GenericObdClient(SimulatorTransport(responses)), [0x0C])
    manager=AcquisitionManager(source, session_id=uuid4(), poll_interval_s=0.02, sink=collect)
    await manager.start()
    await asyncio.sleep(0.09)
    await manager.stop()
    assert manager.state.value == 'STOPPED'
    assert manager.stats['records'] >= 2
    assert sink

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_sink_failure_goes_to_offline_queue(responses,tmp_path):
    async def failing_sink(_): raise RuntimeError('network down')
    queue=OfflineQueue(tmp_path/'queue.jsonl')
    source=ObdPollingSource(GenericObdClient(SimulatorTransport(responses)), [0x0C])
    manager=AcquisitionManager(source, session_id=uuid4(), poll_interval_s=0.02, sink=failing_sink, offline_queue=queue)
    await manager.start(); await asyncio.sleep(0.06); await manager.stop()
    assert queue.size() >= 1
    item=queue.peek(1)[0]
    assert item['source_type']=='OBD_PID'

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_offline_queue_ack(tmp_path):
    q=OfflineQueue(tmp_path/'q.jsonl')
    q.append({'id':1}); q.append({'id':2}); q.append({'id':3})
    assert q.peek(2)==[{'id':1},{'id':2}]
    assert q.ack(2)==2
    assert q.peek(10)==[{'id':3}]

class FlakySource:
    async def connect(self): pass
    async def disconnect(self): pass
    async def read_once(self, session_id, sequence):
        if sequence == 0: raise ConnectionError('drop')
        from vehicle.acquisition.models import AcquisitionRecord
        return [AcquisitionRecord(session_id=session_id, channel='test', numeric_value=1.0, sequence=sequence)]

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_manager_reconnects_after_read_failure():
    manager=AcquisitionManager(FlakySource(), session_id=uuid4(), poll_interval_s=0.01, reconnect_policy=ReconnectPolicy(max_attempts=2, initial_backoff_s=0.001, max_backoff_s=0.002))
    await manager.start(); await asyncio.sleep(0.05); await manager.stop()
    assert manager.stats['reconnects'] >= 1
    assert manager.stats['records'] >= 1

def test_ble_scan_registers_metadata_and_clamps_timeout(monkeypatch):
    seen = {}
    class FakeScanner:
        @staticmethod
        async def discover(timeout):
            seen["timeout"] = timeout
            return [
                types.SimpleNamespace(
                    address="AA:BB:CC",
                    name="BLE VCI",
                    rssi=-42,
                    metadata={"manufacturer": "test"},
                ),
                types.SimpleNamespace(address="DD:EE:FF", name=None),
            ]
    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, "bleak", types.SimpleNamespace(BleakScanner=FakeScanner))
    manager = VCIConnectionManager()

    found = asyncio.run(manager.scan("ble", timeout=90))

    assert seen["timeout"] == 30.0
    assert len(found) == 2
    assert found[0].device_id == "ble:AA:BB:CC"
    assert found[0].metadata["rssi"] == -42
    assert found[0].metadata["details"] == {"manufacturer": "test"}
    assert found[1].model == "BLE VCI"
    assert manager.devices[found[0].device_id] is found[0]

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_connection_status_reconnect_and_connected_obd_lifecycle():
    manager = VCIConnectionManager()
    device = manager.add_simulator()

    connected = await manager.connect(device.device_id)
    assert connected.status == DeviceStatus.CONNECTED
    assert manager.connected_obd(device.device_id) is manager.connections[device.device_id].obd
    assert manager.status(device.device_id).status == DeviceStatus.CONNECTED

    await manager.connections[device.device_id].transport.disconnect()
    assert manager.status(device.device_id).status == DeviceStatus.ERROR

    reconnected = await manager.reconnect(device.device_id)
    assert reconnected.status == DeviceStatus.CONNECTED
    disconnected = await manager.disconnect(device.device_id)
    assert disconnected.status == DeviceStatus.DISCONNECTED
    assert device.device_id not in manager.connections

def test_simulator_device_connects_and_reads_obd_values():

    assert dtcs == ["P0102"]
    assert live["rpm"] == 1696.0
    assert live["coolant_c"] == 50.0
    assert live["speed_kmh"] == 40.0

class QueueBus:
    def __init__(self, frames=()):
        self.frames = list(frames)
        self.sent = []
    async def send(self, frame):
        self.sent.append(frame)
    async def receive(self, timeout_ms=1000):
        if self.frames:
            return self.frames.pop(0)
        return None

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_send_handles_wait_cts_block_size_and_extended_frames(monkeypatch):
    payload = b"0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMN"
    bus = QueueBus([
        CanFrame(0x18DAF110, b"\x31\x01\x00", is_extended=True),
        CanFrame(0x18DAF110, b"\x30\x01\x00", is_extended=True),
        CanFrame(0x18DAF110, b"\x30\x00\x00", is_extended=True),
    ])
    # Replace sleep with an async no-op so STmin/block handling never incurs wall-clock delay.
    async def no_sleep(_seconds):
        return None
    monkeypatch.setattr(asyncio, "sleep", no_sleep)
    stack = IsoTpStack(bus, 0x18DA10F1, 0x18DAF110, extended=True)
    await stack.send(payload)
    assert bus.sent[0].data[0] >> 4 == 1
    assert all(frame.is_extended for frame in bus.sent)
    assert len(bus.sent) >= 4

"""Canonical vehicle-core import regardless of PYTHONPATH ordering.

No physical adapters or cloud network are accessed.

import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
BACKEND = ROOT / "backend"


def _probe(paths, cwd):
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env["PYTHONPATH"] = os.pathsep.join(map(str, paths))
    check = (
        "import vehicle.obd.client as c; "
        "import vehicle.protocol.registry as r; "
        "assert callable(c.GenericObdClient.connect); "
        "assert len(r.PROTOCOLS) >= 20; "
        "print(c.__file__)"
    )
    return subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-c", check], cwd=cwd, env=env,
        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20,
    )


def test_root_first_import_resolves_real_obd_client(tmp_path):
    result = _probe([ROOT, BACKEND], tmp_path)
    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
    assert "backend" + os.sep + "vehicle" in result.stdout
    assert "vehicle" + os.sep + "obd" + os.sep + "client.py" in result.stdout


def test_backend_first_import_resolves_same_shared_core(tmp_path):
    result = _probe([BACKEND, ROOT], tmp_path)
    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
    assert "backend" + os.sep + "vehicle" in result.stdout
    assert "vehicle" + os.sep + "obd" + os.sep + "client.py" in result.stdout

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
from uuid import uuid4

import pytest

from vehicle.acquisition.manager import AcquisitionManager
from vehicle.acquisition.models import AcquisitionRecord, AcquisitionSourceType, AcquisitionState, ReconnectPolicy
from vehicle.acquisition.offline_queue import OfflineQueue


class FakeSource:
    def __init__(self, *, connect_failures=0, read_failures=0):
        self.connect_failures = connect_failures
        self.read_failures = read_failures
        self.connect_calls = 0
        self.disconnect_calls = 0
        self.read_calls = 0

    async def connect(self):
        self.connect_calls += 1
        if self.connect_calls <= self.connect_failures:
            raise OSError("connect failed")

    async def disconnect(self):
        self.disconnect_calls += 1

    async def read_once(self, session_id, sequence):
        self.read_calls += 1
        if self.read_calls <= self.read_failures:
            raise RuntimeError("read failed")
        return [AcquisitionRecord(
            session_id=session_id, source_type=AcquisitionSourceType.OBD_PID,
            channel="rpm", numeric_value=750.0, unit="rpm", sequence=sequence,
            raw=b"\x02\xee",
        )]


def _policy(attempts=2):
    return ReconnectPolicy(max_attempts=attempts, initial_backoff_s=0.001, max_backoff_s=0.005)


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_manager_retries_connect_delivers_records_and_stops_cleanly():
    sid = uuid4()
    source = FakeSource(connect_failures=1)
    delivered = []
    async def sink(records):
        delivered.extend(records)

    manager = AcquisitionManager(
        source, session_id=sid, poll_interval_s=0.005,
        reconnect_policy=_policy(), sink=sink,
    )
    await manager.start()
    await asyncio.sleep(0.025)
    await manager.stop()

    assert source.connect_calls >= 2
    assert source.disconnect_calls == 1
    assert manager.state is AcquisitionState.STOPPED
    assert manager.stats["records"] >= 1
    assert delivered
    assert all(item.session_id == sid for item in manager.snapshot(2))
    assert manager.snapshot(0) == []
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="limit"):
        manager.snapshot(-1)


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_manager_connection_failure_sets_error_state():
    manager = AcquisitionManager(
        FakeSource(connect_failures=99), session_id=uuid4(),
        reconnect_policy=_policy(attempts=2),
    )
    with pytest.raises(ConnectionError, match="connect failed"):
        await manager.start()
    assert manager.state is AcquisitionState.ERROR
    assert manager.stats["errors"] == 2


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_manager_reconnects_after_read_error_and_queues_when_sink_fails(tmp_path):
    source = FakeSource(read_failures=1)
    queue = OfflineQueue(tmp_path / "offline.jsonl", max_items=4)
    def failed_sink(_records):
        raise OSError("network unavailable")

    manager = AcquisitionManager(
        source, session_id=uuid4(), poll_interval_s=0.005,
        reconnect_policy=_policy(), offline_queue=queue, sink=failed_sink,
    )
    await manager.start()
    await asyncio.sleep(0.035)
    await manager.stop()

    assert manager.stats["reconnects"] >= 1
    assert manager.stats["queued_offline"] >= 1
    assert queue.size() >= 1
    first = queue.peek(1)[0]
    assert first["channel"] == "rpm"
    assert first["raw_hex"] == "02ee"
    assert first["source_type"] == "OBD_PID"


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_manager_rejects_nonpositive_poll_interval_and_start_is_idempotent():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="poll_interval_s"):
        AcquisitionManager(FakeSource(), session_id=uuid4(), poll_interval_s=0)

    source = FakeSource()
    manager = AcquisitionManager(source, session_id=uuid4(), poll_interval_s=0.01)
    await manager.start()
    await manager.start()
    assert source.connect_calls == 1

async def test_multibus_runtime_connects_routes_gateway_and_runs_read_only_operations():

        session_id=uuid4(),
        topology=_topology(),
        buses=(CanBusConfig("CAN0"), CanBusConfig("CAN1", bitrate=250_000, can_fd=True, data_bitrate=2_000_000)),
    )
    try:
        await runtime.connect()
        await runtime.connect()  # reconnecting an active runtime is idempotent

from vehicle.adapters.can_simulator import SimulatedCanBus

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_demultiplexer_routes_matching_frames_to_registered_channels():
    bus = SimulatedCanBus()
    mux = CanBusDemultiplexer(bus, poll_timeout_ms=5)
    channel_a = mux.register(0x7E8)
    channel_b = mux.register(0x7E9)

    await mux.start()
    await mux.start()  # idempotent start
    frame_a = CanFrame(0x7E8, b"\x02\x41\x0C")
    frame_b = CanFrame(0x7E9, b"\x02\x41\x0D")
    bus.inject(frame_a)
    bus.inject(frame_b)
    assert await channel_a.receive(timeout_ms=100) == frame_a
    assert await channel_b.receive(timeout_ms=100) == frame_b

    assert await channel_a.receive(timeout_ms=1) is None
    await mux.stop()
    await mux.stop()
    assert mux._task is None


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_demultiplexer_tracks_unmatched_frames_and_caps_history():
    bus = SimulatedCanBus()
    mux = CanBusDemultiplexer(bus, poll_timeout_ms=5)
    for index in range(1002):
        bus.inject(CanFrame(0x100, bytes([index % 256])))

    await mux.start()
    for _ in range(100):
        if len(mux.unmatched_frames) == 501:
            break
        await asyncio.sleep(0.001)
    await mux.stop()

    assert len(mux.unmatched_frames) == 502
    assert mux.unmatched_frames[-1].data == bytes([1001 % 256])
    channel = mux.register(0x7E8)
    mux.unregister(channel)
    assert 0x7E8 not in mux._channels
    mux.unregister(channel)  # unregister is safe even for an unknown channel

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_routed_channel_send_and_multiple_subscribers_receive_same_response():
    bus = SimulatedCanBus()
    mux = CanBusDemultiplexer(bus, poll_timeout_ms=5)
    channel_a = mux.register(0x7E8)
    channel_b = mux.register(0x7E8)
    request = CanFrame(0x7E0, b"\x01\x03")
    await channel_a.send(request)
    assert bus.pop_tx() == request

    await mux.start()
    response = CanFrame(0x7E8, b"\x02\x41\x0C")
    bus.inject(response)
    assert await channel_a.receive(timeout_ms=100) == response
    assert await channel_b.receive(timeout_ms=100) == response

    mux.unregister(channel_a)
    assert len(mux._channels[0x7E8]) == 1
    mux.unregister(channel_b)
    assert 0x7E8 not in mux._channels
    await mux.stop()

def test_uds_simulator_handles_ignored_frames_and_releases_multiframe_response():
    bus = SimulatedCanBus()
    ecu = UdsEcuSimulator(bus, request_id=0x7E0, response_id=0x7E8, vin="VIN12345678901234")

    # Different arbitration ID and empty ISO-TP single frame are ignored.
    import asyncio
    asyncio.run(ecu.on_tx(CanFrame(0x7E1, b"\x02\x10\x03")))
    asyncio.run(ecu.on_tx(CanFrame(0x7E0, b"\x00")))
    assert not bus.rx

    # VIN read is larger than a single CAN frame; the simulator queues
    # consecutive frames until the client grants flow control.
    asyncio.run(ecu.on_tx(CanFrame(0x7E0, b"\x03\x22\xF1\x90")))
    assert len(bus.rx) == 1
    assert bus.rx[0].data[0] >> 4 == 1
    assert ecu._pending_cf

    asyncio.run(ecu.on_tx(CanFrame(0x7E0, b"\x30\x00\x00")))
    assert not ecu._pending_cf
    assert len(bus.rx) == 3
    assert all(frame.arbitration_id == 0x7E8 for frame in bus.rx)
    assert bus.rx[1].data[0] >> 4 == 2

def test_uds_simulator_queues_single_frame_and_legacy_process_drains_tx():
    bus = SimulatedCanBus()
    ecu = UdsEcuSimulator(bus)

    ecu._queue_response(b"\x50\x03")
    assert len(bus.rx) == 1
    assert bus.rx[0].data == b"\x02\x50\x03"

    # Keep the backward-compatible synchronous processing loop deterministic:
    # replace the async transport hook with a synchronous recorder for this unit.
    seen = []
    ecu.on_tx = lambda frame: seen.append(frame.arbitration_id)
    bus.tx.append(CanFrame(0x7E0, b"\x01\x03"))
    bus.tx.append(CanFrame(0x7E1, b"\x01\x03"))
    ecu.process()
    assert seen == [0x7E0, 0x7E1]
    assert bus.pop_tx() is None

import pytest
from uuid import uuid4
from vehicle.adapters.can_simulator import SimulatedCanBus
from vehicle.adapters.uds_simulator import UdsEcuSimulator
from vehicle.isotp.stack import IsoTpStack
from vehicle.protocol.trace import ProtocolTraceRecorder, TracedCanBus
from vehicle.uds.client import UdsClient
from vehicle.uds.decoder import format_uds_dtc, parse_dtc_information
from vehicle.uds.diagnostics import UdsDiagnosticSession


def test_format_and_parse_dtc():
    raw = 0x030200
    assert format_uds_dtc(raw) == 'P030200'
    payload = bytes([0x02, 0xFF]) + raw.to_bytes(3, 'big') + b'\x28'
    records = parse_dtc_information(payload)
    assert len(records) == 1
    assert records[0].code == 'P030200'
    assert records[0].status_byte == 0x28


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_read_only_uds_identity_and_dtcs_multiframe():
    bus = SimulatedCanBus(); UdsEcuSimulator(bus, vin='VINTEST1234567890')
    recorder = ProtocolTraceRecorder(session_id=uuid4()); traced = TracedCanBus(bus, recorder)
    client = UdsClient(IsoTpStack(traced, 0x7E0, 0x7E8))
    diag = UdsDiagnosticSession(client)
    identity = await diag.identify_ecu()
    assert identity.vin == 'VINTEST1234567890'
    records = await diag.read_dtcs()
    assert records and records[0].status_byte == 0x28
    assert len(recorder.snapshot()) >= 8
    assert diag.supports_clear_dtc is False

import pytest
from vehicle.uds.client import UdsClient, UdsError

class LoopbackIsoTp:
    def __init__(self): self.sent=[]; self.responses=[]
    async def send(self,p): self.sent.append(p)
    async def receive(self): return self.responses.pop(0)

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_uds_positive_response():
    t=LoopbackIsoTp(); t.responses=[b'\x50\x03']; c=UdsClient(t)
    assert await c.diagnostic_session_control(3)==b'\x03'
    assert t.sent==[b'\x10\x03']

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_uds_negative_response():
    t=LoopbackIsoTp(); t.responses=[b'\x7f\x22\x31']; c=UdsClient(t)
    with pytest.raises(UdsError) as e: await c.read_data_by_identifier(0xF190)
    assert e.value.nrc==0x31

from vehicle.can.models import CanFrame
from vehicle.network.discovery import VehicleNetworkDiscoveryEngine, CanIdObservation


def frame(fid: int, ts: int, data: bytes = b"\x10\x03"):
    return CanFrame(arbitration_id=fid, data=data, timestamp_ns=ts)


def test_profiles_and_periodicity():
    result = VehicleNetworkDiscoveryEngine().analyze(
        [frame(0x100, 0), frame(0x100, 100_000_000), frame(0x100, 200_000_000)], bus="CAN0"
    )
    p = result.profiles[0]
    assert p.arbitration_id == 0x100
    assert p.frame_count == 3
    assert p.periodicity_ms == 100.0


def test_infers_uds_request_response_pair_without_confirming_ecu():
    obs = [
        CanIdObservation("CAN0", 0x7E0, 0, 2, "1003"),
        CanIdObservation("CAN0", 0x7E8, 2_000_000, 2, "5003"),
        CanIdObservation("CAN0", 0x7E0, 100_000_000, 2, "1003"),
        CanIdObservation("CAN0", 0x7E8, 102_000_000, 2, "5003"),
    ]
    result = VehicleNetworkDiscoveryEngine().analyze_observations(obs)
    assert [(p.request_id, p.response_id) for p in result.uds_pairs] == [(0x7E0, 0x7E8)]
    assert result.ecu_candidates[0].classification == "UDS_REQUEST_RESPONSE_INFERRED"
    assert result.ecu_candidates[0].confidence < 1.0


def test_unpaired_active_ids_are_observed_nodes():
    result = VehicleNetworkDiscoveryEngine().analyze(
        [frame(0x120, 0), frame(0x120, 10_000_000)], bus="CAN1"
    )
    assert len(result.ecu_candidates) == 1
    candidate = result.ecu_candidates[0]
    assert candidate.classification == "OBSERVED_CAN_NODE"
    assert candidate.request_id is None
    assert candidate.response_id is None


def test_multi_bus_analysis():
    engine = VehicleNetworkDiscoveryEngine()
    obs = [
        CanIdObservation("CAN0", 0x700, 0, 1, "01"),
        CanIdObservation("CAN0", 0x700, 100_000_000, 1, "01"),
        CanIdObservation("CAN1", 0x7E0, 0, 2, "1003"),
        CanIdObservation("CAN1", 0x7E8, 1_000_000, 2, "5003"),
        CanIdObservation("CAN1", 0x7E0, 100_000_000, 2, "1003"),
        CanIdObservation("CAN1", 0x7E8, 101_000_000, 2, "5003"),
    ]
    result = engine.analyze_observations(obs)
    assert {p.bus for p in result.profiles} == {"CAN0", "CAN1"}
    assert any(p.bus == "CAN1" for p in result.uds_pairs)

import pytest
from vehicle.adapters.can_simulator import SimulatedCanBus
from vehicle.adapters.uds_simulator import UdsEcuSimulator
from vehicle.network.active_discovery import ActiveEcuDiscoveryEngine, ActiveProbePolicy, ActiveProbeTarget

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_active_probe_confirms_identity_read_only():
    bus = SimulatedCanBus()
    UdsEcuSimulator(bus, request_id=0x7E0, response_id=0x7E8, vin='ACTIVEVIN1234567', software_version='SW-9', hardware_version='HW-2')
    engine = ActiveEcuDiscoveryEngine(ActiveProbePolicy(timeout_ms=500, inter_probe_ms=0))
    out = await engine.probe_many([ActiveProbeTarget('DISC_ECU_001','CAN0',0x7E0,0x7E8)], {'CAN0': bus})
    assert out[0].classification == 'CONFIRMED_UDS_ECU'
    assert out[0].identity['vin'] == 'ACTIVEVIN1234567'
    assert out[0].successful_dids == ('0xF190','0xF187','0xF191')

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_active_probe_no_response_is_not_confirmation():
    bus = SimulatedCanBus()
    engine = ActiveEcuDiscoveryEngine(ActiveProbePolicy(timeout_ms=150, inter_probe_ms=0))
    out = await engine.probe_many([ActiveProbeTarget('DISC_ECU_099','CAN0',0x700,0x708)], {'CAN0': bus})
    assert out[0].classification == 'NO_RESPONSE'
    assert not out[0].responded

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_only_allowlisted_read_dids_are_sent():
    bus = SimulatedCanBus(); seen=[]
    def hook(frame):
        if frame.arbitration_id == 0x7E0 and frame.data:
            seen.append(bytes(frame.data))
    bus.add_tx_hook(hook)
    UdsEcuSimulator(bus, request_id=0x7E0, response_id=0x7E8, vin='VIN1234567890123')
    engine = ActiveEcuDiscoveryEngine(ActiveProbePolicy(allowed_dids=(0xF190,), timeout_ms=500, inter_probe_ms=0))
    out = await engine.probe_many([ActiveProbeTarget('DISC_ECU_002','CAN0',0x7E0,0x7E8)], {'CAN0': bus})
    assert out[0].classification == 'CONFIRMED_UDS_ECU'
    uds_payloads = [x[1:1+x[0]] for x in seen if (x[0] & 0xF0) == 0]
    assert uds_payloads and uds_payloads[0] == b'\x22\xF1\x90'


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_active_probe_correlates_gateway_access_path():
    from vehicle.network.models import EcuNode, GatewayNode, GatewayRoute, VehicleNetworkTopology
    from vehicle.network.multibus import GatewayRoutingEngine
    can0, can1 = SimulatedCanBus(), SimulatedCanBus()
    topology = VehicleNetworkTopology(
        ecus=(EcuNode('engine','Engine ECU',0x7E0,0x7E8,bus='CAN1',gateway_id='gw',metadata={'vin':'GWACTIVE12345678'}),),
        gateways=(GatewayNode('gw','Central Gateway','CAN0'),),
        routes=(GatewayRoute('gw','CAN0','CAN1','engine'),),
    )
    gateway = GatewayRoutingEngine({'CAN0':can0,'CAN1':can1}, topology); gateway.install()
    UdsEcuSimulator(can1, request_id=0x7E0, response_id=0x7E8, vin='GWACTIVE12345678')
    engine = ActiveEcuDiscoveryEngine(ActiveProbePolicy(allowed_dids=(0xF190,), timeout_ms=500, inter_probe_ms=0))
    out = await engine.probe_many([ActiveProbeTarget('DISC_ECU_GW','CAN0',0x7E0,0x7E8,'gw')], {'CAN0':can0,'CAN1':can1})
    assert out[0].classification == 'CONFIRMED_UDS_ECU'
    assert out[0].gateway_id == 'gw'
    assert out[0].identity['vin'] == 'GWACTIVE12345678'
